jobs.title: Kirketjenerafløser til Hostrup Kirke
jobs.description:
Vi søger en fast afløser for vores kirketjener. Du vil primært arbejde i Hostrup Kirke, men skal også forvente opgaver i andre af sognets bygninger f.eks. kapellet, præstegården og menighedshuset.

Du skal være indstillet på, at jobbet indebærer weekendarbejde ca. 13 weekender pr. år og arbejde på enkelte helligdage i løbet af året. Tiltrædelse ved sygdom kan også forekomme.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på gennemsnitligt 1 time om ugen. Timerne samles, så der som udgangspunkt arbejdes 4 timer pr. tjeneste.

Stillingen kan udvides og kombineres med opgaver som vedligeholdelse af udendørsområderne omkring kirken så som græsklipning, snerydning og saltning.

Dine opgaver:
  • Kirketjeneste-opgaver, herunder klargøring og medvirken til gudstjenester, særgudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer.
  • Lettere rengøring i kirken og kirkens inventar, vedligehold og oprydning.
  • Betjening af de tekniske installationer i kirkens bygninger f.eks. AV-udstyr og ringning af kirkeklokker ved tjenester.
Vi ser gerne, at du:

Der kan være mange indgange til jobbet. Ideelt set har du erfaring som kirketjener eller en anden funktion med kirkelige handlinger.

Derudover er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Har lyst til at indgå i kirkens arbejde.
  • Som kirkens ansigt udadtil skal fremstå imødekommende og smilende og have lyst til at indgå i dialog med menigheden.
  • Har overblik og ordenssans og tager naturligt ansvar for dine opgaver, som du selvstændigt løser.

Der er pligt til at gøre tjeneste ved andre ansættelsesmyndigheder i i overensstemmelse med de aftaler menighedsrådet indgår med andre ansættelsesmyndigheder.

Ansættelse sker ved Hostrup Sogns Menighedsråd beliggende Solvigvej 1, Hostrup, 6270 Tønder.

Ansøgningsfrist og nærmere oplysninger

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning, CV og eventuelt andre relevante bilag til os via ansøgningsformularen senest den 15. september 2026. Ansøgningsformularen tilgås via stillingsopslaget, som også kan tilgås via dette link: Ledige stillinger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller har du brug for nærmere oplysninger, er du velkommen til at kontakte personaleansvarlig Carina Clausen på mail: 9059@sogn.dk eller telefonisk på 42924300.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet referencer.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgave som kirketjener, graver, kirkegårdsleder eller stor administrationschef indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalerne kan ses på https://folkekirkensintranet.dk/vejledninger/menighedsraadet-som-arbejdsgiver/ok24.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 322.596,68 kr. – 406.233,97 kr. (nutidskroner).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.018,72 kr. (nutidskroner).

OK tillæg på 1.391,59 kr. (nutidskroner) pr. år.

Bemærk: de oplyste beløb er ved en fuldtidsstilling. Løn, OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk. Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening.

Hotellet har komfortable rom, moderne fasiliteter og et vennlig personale som er dedikert til å gi våre gjester en uforglemmelig opplevelse. jobs.title: Skolkurator till VBU i Ludvika/Smedjebacken
jobs.description:
Skolkurator till VBU i Ludvika/Smedjebacken

Om VBU Västerbergslagens utbildningsförbund, VBU, är ett kommunalförbund som bedriver gymnasial utbildning, vuxenutbildning, yrkeshögskoleutbildning och uppdragsutbildning. Vi arbetar på uppdrag av Ludvika och Smedjebackens kommuner. VBU har ca 250 anställda, ca 1 800 elever och omsätter ca 225 Mkr. Vår verksamhet bedrivs i Ludvika, Smedjebacken och Grängesberg. Mer information om våra olika skolor hittar du på vår hemsida.

Arbetsuppgifter

I uppdraget som skolkurator ansvarar du tillsammans med skolledning och övriga i elevhälsoteamet för att elevhälsans insatser på bästa sätt bidrar till elevernas måluppfyllelse och att eleverna ges goda förutsättningar för hälsa och lärande. Enligt skollagen ska elevhälsan främst arbeta hälsofrämjande och förebyggande. Skolkuratorn tillför skolan psykosocial kompetens på individ-, grupp- och organisationsnivå och arbetar på uppdrag av rektor.

I uppdraget som helhet arbetar du utifrån beprövad erfarenhet och evidens med psykosociala insatser direkt riktade till grupper eller enskilda elever. Du arbetar lösningsfokuserat och försöker alltid se de bitarna som är positiva och bygger därifrån. I uppdraget ingår bland annat att göra gruppinriktade insatser, ha enskilda samtal med elever, genomföra kartläggningar och att handleda personal i vissa ärenden. I uppdraget ingår även att ha kontakter med andra myndigheter.

Du ger och tar stöd i yrkesspecifika frågor i din yrkeskategori som du träffar regelbundet. Ni är tre skolkuratorer som samarbetar över hela VBU, men ditt fokus finns till största del mot ett par av våra skolenheter.

Kompetens och erfarenhet

Vi söker dig som är utbildad socionom och har kunskaper inom socialtjänstens juridik och skolans styrdokument. Du kan organisera och prioritera arbetet på ett effektivt sätt som leder till resultat. Som person är du initiativrik, nyfiken, positiv och utvecklar dig genom att ta del av ny forskning och samverka med andra kollegor. Arbetet kräver god samarbetsförmåga, helhetssyn och flexibilitet. På VBU arbetar vi utifrån vår värdegrund som innebär att alla medarbetare skapar delaktighet, trygghet och samarbete genom öppenhet och respekt. Detta gäller i varje situation och i varje relation.

Du är trygg med att arbeta i både mindre och större grupper av elever och personal. Du har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa goda arbetsrelationer. Erfarenhet av arbete med barn och ungdomar är önskvärt och meriterande. Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som skolkurator är starkt meriterande. Vi ser även en fördel om du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom socialtjänsten mot barn och unga, eller tidigare tjänst inom barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin. Personlig lämplighet är av stor vikt.

Särskilt meriterande:

    Vidareutbildning som hälso- och sjukvårdskurator.

Meriterande är även erfarenhet och framgång genom att använda olika verktyg såsom motiverande samtal (MI) eller andra verktyg som är effektiva i det vardagliga arbetet med att motivera elever till en bättre hälsa och ett bättre lärande.

Om anställningsvillkoren

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning och tjänsteformen är semestertjänst på heltid med start 1 oktober 2026 eller efter överenskommelse. Provanställning förekommer. Vi begär ett uppvisande av utdrag ur belastningsregistret vid anställning. Mer information om vår verksamhet och uppdraget får du under rekryteringsprocessen. Körkort är ett krav.

Om ansökan

Du ansöker genom att registrera din profil och bifoga ett personligt brev och CV i vårt rekryteringssystem. Bifoga relevanta examensbevis i din ansökan. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-08-07. Intervjuer och urval kan påbörjas före sista ansökningsdag. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

    Mariella Andersson, Verksamhetschef Gymnasiet | 0240-86792 | mariella.andersson@vbu.ludvika.se

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer in Sustainable Process and Water Engineering
jobs.description:
The School of Smart Solutions educates future professionals in electrical and automation engineering, electronics and robotics, energy and environmental engineering, biotechnology and food engineering, chemical engineering, and laboratory science. Our graduates play an important role in advancing sustainable development and providing companies and society with solutions for climate change mitigation, the green transition, and resource-efficient industrial operations.

Do you want to actively shape a sustainable future and inspire the next generation of professionals? We are now looking for a Senior Lecturer in Sustainable Process and Water Engineering, with a particular focus on digital water solutions and technologies, for a permanent full-time position. If you are an experienced expert in this field, we look forward to receiving your application.

Role Description

As a Senior Lecturer, you will primarily teach on campus and design pedagogy, including online learning materials, laboratory work and project work. You will also help develop the curriculum to meet the evolving needs of the modern workforce and participate in multidisciplinary projects with industrial partners.

Your role combines theory and practice in teaching, laboratory instruction, thesis supervision, RDI activities, and project collaboration at Metropolias Myyrmäki campus. You will work closely with companies and other stakeholders in the process, chemical, environmental, and water technology sectors.

The position may also include teaching and collaboration with partner universities abroad (including international travel), as well as participation in education export and business-related activities.

Minimum Requirements

- Relevant Masters degree in technology (e.g. MSc or MEng)

- At least three years of relevant industrial work experience

- Strong understanding of industry needs and an established professional network in the process and/or water sector

- Ability to work directly with companies and integrate real industrial cases into teaching, research and development

- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a diverse, international environment

- Fluency in English and willingness to learn Finnish (support provided)

- Professional Teacher Education qualification. If you do not yet have the required pedagogical studies for teachers, these can be completed alongside your work within three years of being appointed.

What We Value

- Doctoral degree (PhD, ScD, EngD or equivalent)

- Experience in
- process, chemical, environmental or water engineering, or related industrial operations

- industrial processes, raw materials, process balances, quality management, HSEQ, product and process safety, and riskbased thinkingmaintenance interfaces, CAD tools, technical drawings, and process documentation (e.g. PFDs, P&IDs)


- Interest in
- digital water solutions and modern tools (e.g. monitoring systems, sensor and process data, modelling, data analytics, AI, simulation)

- material and energy efficiency, process design and industrial operating environments


- Genuine enthusiasm for sustainable process and water engineering and the green transition

- Proven experience of industry collaboration and ability to build and maintain company relationships

- Motivation to develop teaching and applied learning environments, and to use pedagogically sound methods

- Willingness to develop your own expertise, stay current in your field and bring new ideas into teaching and learning

What We Offer

We offer you an opportunity to work with enthusiastic colleagues in a supportive and multidisciplinary community. You will have the chance to develop your teaching, professional expertise, and pedagogical skills while contributing to education, applied research, and collaboration with industry and international partners.

The salary and terms of employment are determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Universities of Applied Sciences. The starting salary for a Senior Lecturer is typically between EUR 4,500 and 6,000 per month, depending on the selected candidates experience, qualifications, and background.

Application Process

The deadline for applications is Monday, 24 August 2026 at 16:00 (EET, Finnish time). Please submit your application together with your CV and a free-form description of your teaching philosophy.

Join us in shaping the future of education at the School of Smart Solutions!

For further information, please contact:

Tomi Hämäläinen, Head of Smart Energy, School of Smart Solutions, Tomi.Hamalainen@metropolia.fi


Metropolia University of Applied Sciences

Metropolia University of Applied Sciences, Finlands largest university of applied sciences, educates future professionals in the fields of Business, Culture, Health Care and Social Services, and Technology. Metropolia is a community of 19,000 students and more than 1,200 experts. In Metropolia, people and worlds meet to create insight, expertise and well-being.

As a bold reformer of higher education, we build a sustainable future in close cooperation with businesses and various organisations. As a solution-oriented higher education institution, we support fresh ideas, new innovations and bold experiments. Every year, we conduct more than 100 research and development projects for the good of society and people. Metropolias turnover is 135 million euros, of which RDI and business operations represent a growing share.

We value the diversity of our working community and work towards achieving equality. We welcome applicants from various background.

Make a difference with us – join Metropolia.

    Du kommer regelbundet att resa till olika kundplatser inom Sverige, men främst i södra sverige

Kunskap, färdigheter och erfarenhet:

Thales ger företag och myndigheter världen över möjligheten att erbjuda trygga och tillgängliga digitala tjänster till miljoner individer. Jag en aktiv 27-årig tjej som älskar djur, musik, skapa, läsa, laga mat och träna. Din arbetsplats är mest i stallet, på mina jobb eller hemma. Jag rider flera gånger i veckan och sköter mina katter varje dag. Att gå promenader i skogen gillar jag också. Jag hälsar på familj och vänner ofta och är mycket med min syster. Därför kan du inte ha allergi och behöver god fysik, med inga egna fysiska skador. Körkort är ett plus!

Du är bra på att hålla dig i bakgrunden och ge service, så att jag kan leva mitt liv. Dina arbetstider är varierande, med varannan helg och 5-6 journattpass/månad. När jag rider arbetar två assistenter. Arbetslaget består av olika åldrar, kön och etnisk bakgrund. Vi har kollektivavtal och friskvårdsbidrag.

Personliga egenskaper:

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, lyhörd och har förmågan att skapa en trygg och tillitsfull relation med kunden. Du är noggrann och pålitlig samt har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och ta egna initiativ när det behövs. Det är viktigt att du är följsam och respektfull gentemot kundens integritet och önskemål. Du har inga problem med axlar eller rygg då en del tunga lyft förekommer i arbetet.

Vad vi erbjuder dig som anställd:

    En meningsfull och givande arbetsuppgift där du kan göra verklig skillnad i en persons liv.

Monument Assistans är alternativet för personer med personlig assistans som söker skräddarsydda lösningar. Vi har hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet av personlig assistans. Vi vet att vår personal är nyckeln till att bedriva en bra personlig assistans. Därför är det centralt för oss att du som medarbetare är både känner stolthet och glädje över att arbeta hos oss. Vi erbjuder dig goda lönevillkor, ett nära ledarskap och friskvårdsersättning. Vi ger dig en arbetsmiljö där det är högt i tak och där du har goda möjligheter att påverka din egen arbetssituation. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Please note that: we are not currently hiring for this role at this moment, but we encourage you to apply and be among the first candidates considered when the position becomes available.**

**The Role**

**We're looking for a Data Scientist to do the quantitative analysis behind a large-scale data quality program. When our data engineering team's monitors flag a statistical anomaly in large, human-generated rating and annotation data, you'll be the one who determines whether it's genuine signal or ordinary noise, and if it's real, what's actually driving it. You'll triage confirmed findings into the right remediation lane, turn your analysis into fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups, and help build the dashboards and reporting views that make your findings visible to the team and stakeholders. You'll operate on a two-week sprint cadence as part of a small, distributed team, reporting into the program's Data Scientist Lead.**

**What You'll Do**

- **Take anomalies flagged by the data engineering team's monitoring systems and apply statistical methods (hypothesis testing, distributional comparisons, cohort/segment analysis) to classify each as genuine signal or ordinary noise/drift.**

- **Run root-cause analysis on confirmed anomalies in rating/annotation data — for example, comparing cohorts to identify what distinguishes an outlier group from the rest of the population — to identify the likely driver.**

- **Triage confirmed findings into the correct remediation lane: contributor-side issues (route to our internal Quality team for remediation) versus process-side issues (route back to the client's program team as a guideline or workflow fix).**

- **Turn analysis into clear, concise, fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups that feed the team's stakeholder cadence, owned by the Data Scientist Lead.**

- **Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting views (in partnership with data engineering) that surface anomaly trends, cohort findings, and turnaround metrics to the team and stakeholders.**

- **Work within tight, SLA-driven turnaround windows, delivering diagnosis-ready findings within hours — not days — once an issue is flagged.**

- **Participate fully in a two-week sprint cadence: sprint planning, review, and continuous improvement of analysis methodology.**

- **Collaborate cross-functionally with data engineers, the Data Scientist Lead, and program/quality stakeholders across a distributed, international team.**


**What You'll Need**

- **3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Statistician, or Quantitative Analyst.**

- **Strong background in statistical analysis and hypothesis testing — comfortable choosing and applying the right test (e.g., distributional comparison tests) to determine whether two groups genuinely differ.**

- **Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including standard statistical/analysis libraries.**

- **Demonstrated experience distinguishing genuine patterns from noise or drift in large, messy, human-generated datasets.**

- **Experience with BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Data Studio).**

- **Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with short sprint cycles.**

- **Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable producing clear write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.**


**Nice to Have**

- **Experience with anomaly and drift detection on human-rated, crowdsourced, or annotation-based datasets.**

- **Prior experience in a data quality, trust & safety, content moderation, or crowdsourced-data environment.**

- **Familiarity with cohort or segmentation profiling techniques for large populations.**


**Project Overview**

**Location: Remote from Finland**

**Type: Full-time, fixed-term engagement of approximately 6 months, with potential to extend based on program needs.**

**WE OFFER**

- **Occupational health care at Terveystalo private clinic**

- **Sport & Culture & Health benefits through EPass**

- **Multicultural environment/diversity and inclusiveness**

- **Charity & well-being activities**

- **Company events**

- **Employee referral bonuses & Recognition programs**


**If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply now!**

**Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted/interviewed.**

**Kindly attach an updated Copy of your CV in English.**

jobs.title: PhD student in Agroecological Crop Management
jobs.description:
Department of Crop Production Ecology

Research subject: Biology with specialisation in ecology

Description of the doctoral project



Crop production is increasingly challenged by multiple, interacting stresses, including drought, heat, nutrient limitations, weeds, pests, and diseases. Crop genetic diversity can strengthen resilience under these conditions, but the expression of resilience depends strongly on the environment and on how crops are managed. Service crops, used as an agroecological management practice, can provide valuable ecosystem services, such as the regulation of weeds, pests, and diseases, as well as nitrogen fixation and the maintenance of soil health and fertility. However, there is still limited understanding of how crop genetic diversity and service crops interact to alleviate multiple stresses - an important knowledge gap that this project will address.



The project will investigate how agroecological management practices influence resilience to multiple stresses in wheat and pea. You will examine how management practices modify genotype responses across growing conditions, with a particular focus on interactions between genotype, environment, and management. The aim is to understand how management practices shape resilience to multiple stresses in different crop genotypes and to identify promising variety–management combinations that support stable performance under low-input conditions.

Experiments will be conducted under field conditions, comparing different agroecological management practices. Measurements will include crop development, phenology, yield, and quality traits, alongside monitoring of a broad range of abiotic and biotic stresses, including drought, heat, nutrient limitation, weeds, pests, and diseases. Biodiversity assessments, microbiome analyses, and environmental observations will provide additional context for evaluating the wider effects of management practices and for interpreting crop performance under field conditions.

As the PhD student in this project, you will gain broad research experience through field experimentation, data processing, statistical analysis, scientific writing, and the communication of research findings. You will work closely with researchers at SLU and with partners in a European research consortium. This collaboration will provide excellent opportunities to develop your scientific expertise, build an international research network, and contribute to research across countries and disciplines

Qualifications

    A second-cycle (MSc) degree in agronomy, crop science, plant biology, ecology, plant breeding, agricultural systems science or a related field
    Documented experience of working with plants, crops, or agricultural systems
    Good knowledge of plant ecology and an understanding of its relevance to sustainable crop production, agroecological management, or crop resilience
    Documented experience in statistical data analysis
    Good command of written and spoken English

The following qualifications would be an advantage:

    Documented experience with crop phenotyping, crop physiology, or genotype evaluation
    Documented experience with field assessment of weeds, pests, diseases, or environmental factors
    Documented experience in scientific writing and communication
    A driving licence valid for use in Sweden

jobs.title: Salin palvelupäällikkö, Original Sokos Hotel Vantaa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
VANTAA

Salin palvelupäällikkö, Original Sokos Hotel Vantaa
Original Sokos Hotel Vantaa on tapahtumien ja tarinoiden legendaarinen hotelli Tikkurilan sydämessä.

Etsimme kokenutta salin palvelupäällikköä liittymään Original Sokos Hotel Vantaa ravintolatiimiin. Työ on monipuolinen ja sijoittuu kaikkiin hotellin ravintoloihin: Amarillo, Rosso Pizza, Tulisuudelma, Pub Hertas sekä Night Vantaa. Tarjoamme vakituisen ja osa-aikaisen (90h/3vko) työsuhteen.

Palvelupäällikkönä toimit esihenkilönä vuorossa olevalle tiimillesi ja mahdollistat heidän onnistumisensa työssään. Vuoron johtamisessa on erinomaisen lähijohtamisen lisäksi tärkeää osata organisoida työvuoroja sekä pystyä yhdistämään laadukas ja tehokas toiminta. Johdat vuoroa positiivisesti omalla esimerkilläsi ajoittain hektisessä työympäristössä ja muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Tässä työtehtävässä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaillemme unohtumattomia elämyksiä. Tehtävässäsi raportoit ravintolapäällikölle.

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ravintola-alalla. Arvostamme erityisesti monipuolista baariosaamista (baarimestarin koulutus katsotaan eduksi) sekä kokemusta a la carte -ravintoloista. Tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa, sillä työ sisältää muun muassa asiakaspalautteisiin vastaamista sekä erilaisten taustatehtävien hoitamista suomeksi.Ennen kaikkea etsimme henkilöä, jolla on erinomainen asenne, vahva palveluhenkisyys sekä kyky innostaa ja johtaa tiimiä esimerkillään.

Monipuoliset työtehtävät

Vahvan tuen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Mahdollisuuden oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamista

S-ryhmän kattavat henkilöstöedut
ostoalennukset S-ryhmän kaupoista, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja liikennemyymälöistä

kattavat työterveyspalvelut

normaalia laajemman vakuutusturvan

Vankkaa kokemusta ravintola-alan esihenkilötehtävistä

Erinomaista asennetta, palveluhenkisyyttä ja kykyä johtaa tiimiä esimerkilläsi

Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sujuvasti eri tiimien kanssa

Vahvaa baariosaamista; baarimestarin koulutus katsotaan eduksi

Kokemusta à la carte -ravintolatyöstä

Kykyä johtaa vuoroa, organisoida työskentelyä ja toimia tehokkaasti myös kiireisissä tilanteissa

Hygienia- ja anniskelupassia

Suomen kielen taitoa


Lisätietoja ja hakuohjeet

Me operoimme Suomessa neljäätoista Sokos Hotels -ketjun hotellia ja kahdeksaa Radisson Hotels -ketjun hotellia. Sokotel Oy toimii pääkaupunkiseudulla, Tampereella ja Oulussa.

jobs.title: Nu söker vi en timvikarie till vårat team!
jobs.description:
Personlig assistent till man i rullstol - Bollebygd

Vi söker nu en engagerad och omtänksam personlig assistent till en man i rullstol. Som assistent kommer du att vara en viktig del av kundens vardag och ge stöd inom olika områden.

I denna roll kommer du att assistera kunden med personlig hygien, måltider, övriga dagliga aktiviteter samt vara behjälplig med att svara i telefonen och hantera kommunikation med externa parter. Kunden är aktiv och gillar att gå på bio, teater och åka på utflykter. Du kommer vara kundens förlängda armar och ben, och din närvaro kommer göra en verklig skillnad i hans liv.  Kunden har en egen bil som assistent kör när man ska på aktiviteter så körkort är ett krav för tjänsten.

Erfarenhet/Kvalifikationer:

    Tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som personlig assistent eller inom vården är meriterande men inte ett krav.
    Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och respektfullt.
    Empatisk och tålamodig samt har förmåga att lyssna och vara stödjande.
    Förmåga att vara flexibel och anpassa sig till kundens behov och önskemål.
    Hantera lyft

Personliga egenskaper:

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, lyhörd och har förmågan att skapa en trygg och tillitsfull relation med kunden. Du är noggrann och pålitlig samt har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och ta egna initiativ när det behövs. Det är viktigt att du är följsam och respektfull gentemot kundens integritet och önskemål. Du har inga problem med axlar eller rygg då en del tunga lyft förekommer i arbetet.

Körkort och bil krävs då det inte går att ta sig till kunden med kollektivtrafik.

Vad vi erbjuder dig som anställd:

    En meningsfull och givande arbetsuppgift där du kan göra verklig skillnad i en persons liv.
    Möjlighet att utveckla din förmåga att kommunicera, arbeta med empati och skapa relationer.
    Ett positivt och stöttande arbetsklimat där din insats uppskattas och värderas högt.

Vi söker nu en timvikarie som kan hoppa in vid sjukdom eller när andra assistenter vill vara lediga. Arbetspassen är dygn (07.30-08.00) med sovande jour.


Om du känner att du har den empati, engagemang och vilja som krävs för att vara en bra personlig assistent, och vill vara en del av att skapa en meningsfull vardag för en annan person, tveka inte att söka till denna position. Vi ser fram emot att få träffa dig och välkomna dig till vårt team!

Monument Assistans är alternativet för personer med personlig assistans som söker skräddarsydda lösningar. Vi har hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet av personlig assistans. För att vi ska kunna hjälpa våra kunder på allra bästa sätt så arbetar vi med hög tillgänglighet och ett nära och personligt samarbete.

Vi vet att vår personal är nyckeln till att bedriva en bra personlig assistans. Därför är det centralt för oss att du som medarbetare är både känner stolthet och glädje över att arbeta hos oss. Vi på Monument Assistans vill därför ge dig möjligheten att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vi uppskattar nyfikna och engagerade medarbetare.

Vi erbjuder dig goda lönevillkor, ett nära ledarskap och friskvårdsersättning. Vi ger dig en arbetsmiljö där det är högt i tak och där du har goda möjligheter att påverka din egen arbetssituation. Vi tar gärna fram individuella fortbildningslösningar beroende på i vilken typ av uppdrag du arbetar i. Hos oss får du möjligheten att växa!

jobs.title: Database Engineer
jobs.description:
Database Engineer – Oracle to PostgreSQL Migration

Location: Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid – 2 days onsite per week)

Employment Type: Contract (6 months with strong possibility of extension)

Start Date: Mid-September 2026

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Database Engineer to join a large-scale database modernization project. In this role, you will play a key part in migrating enterprise database services from Oracle to PostgreSQL while ensuring high performance, stability, and reliability throughout the migration process.

This position combines hands-on migration work with database analysis, optimization, and collaboration with development teams to deliver scalable and maintainable database solutions.

Key Responsibilities

    Plan and execute Oracle-to-PostgreSQL database migration activities.
    Design and implement efficient PostgreSQL database solutions.
    Review database schemas, configurations, and application database interactions.
    Identify performance improvements and optimization opportunities.
    Ensure database integrity, stability, and compatibility during migration.
    Collaborate with software engineers and technical teams throughout the project.
    Prepare technical documentation, migration guidelines, and best practices.

Required Qualifications

    Proven experience as a PostgreSQL Database Administrator or PostgreSQL-focused Database Engineer/Developer.
    Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL administration and performance tuning.
    Solid understanding of Oracle database concepts and architecture.
    Hands-on experience delivering Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration projects.
    Experience with SQL and database design principles.
    Familiarity with Liquibase or similar database versioning and change management tools.
    Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience working with Java applications connected to PostgreSQL.
    Knowledge of distributed systems or messaging platforms such as Kafka or Solace.
    Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude.

jobs.title: Handledare
jobs.employer: Ålands Fountainhouse förening rf / Klubbhuset Pelaren
jobs.description:
Ålands fountainhouse förening r.f. driver verksamheten Klubbhuset Pelaren. Klubbhuset Pelaren ingår i en internationell organisation, Clubhouse International, vars rehabiliteringsmodell vänder sig till människor som har eller har haft psykisk ohälsa. Anställda och medlemmar driver verksamheten gemensamt där man arbetar och bestämmer tillsammans med fokus på verksamhetens utveckling och dess medlemmars bästa. Samarbetsförmåga är en förutsättning likaså ett professionellt, prestigelöst, empatiskt och respektfullt förhållningssätt.

Som handledare på Klubbhuset Pelaren är du både pedagog, inspiratör och kollega, du stöttar medlemmar att så självständigt som möjligt kunna genomföra verksamhetens arbetsuppgifter. Du lär känna de individer du arbetar med och kan anpassa och matcha arbetsuppgift efter person. Klubbhusets arbetsinriktade verksamhet omfattar arbetsuppgifter inom kök, kontor, reception och administration. I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår också att stödja medlemmar till avlönat arbete och studier, kontinuerlig reach-out (kontakt till de som inte kommer), ta emot studiebesök av olika slag, introducera nya i verksamheten, stödja medlemmar i kontakt med bland annat myndigheter, arbeta med gemensamt socialt program och friskvårdsaktiviteter.Vissa kvällar, helger och storhelger ingår i arbetet, samt övernattningar kan förekomma då vi deltar regelbundet på nationella och internationella utbildningar, evenemang och studiebesök.

På Klubbhuset bygger vi relationer och kamratskap genom att arbeta tillsammans sida vid sida. Att kunna bemöta människor som kommer med olika dagsform och som kan vara i behov av stöd och ett lyssnande öra hör till vardagen. Att handledare och medlemmar i huset arbetar sida vid sida, där medlemmen blir sedd, hörd och uppskattad för sina insatser har visat sig vara ett mycket verkningsfullt redskap för tillfrisknande och återhämtning. Positivt tänkande, flexibilitet och arbetsglädje ser vi som en självklarhet. Arbetet som handledare är både utmanande, mångfacetterat och utvecklande. Det bygger på att man tror på människors lika värde och fokuserar på individens resurser och möjligheter.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet med fokus på god social förmåga, ett gott bemötande samt förmåga att inspirera och entusiasmera andra. För tjänsten krävs goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt. B-körkort finska-, IT- och matlagningskunskaper är också meriterande.

We are hiring an Investor Relations Associate to help grow the investor side of Paires, the network of family offices and high-net-worth individuals our founders raise from.

Paires is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

The craft of this seat is allocator trust, and we are hiring people early in that craft who are already showing they have it. You will work alongside our senior investor team on live mandates: qualifying allocators, preparing briefs, running follow-ups, and keeping investor relationships warm between deals. And from day one you will build your own: identifying family offices and HNWIs who back US startups, earning first conversations, and growing a book that is yours.

You do not need a decade of relationships. You need the beginnings of a real network, a method for growing it that you can explain, and the discipline to treat other people's capital and privacy with care. The rest, the mandate craft, the briefing standard, the judgment calls, you learn here, working next to people who do this every day. One thing this seat is not: technical. Our engineers build the platform and the agents. You work inside them, so your hours go to investors instead of admin.

What you will own

  • Your growing book. The allocator relationships you bring and the ones you open here, qualified and kept warm.

  • Mandate support that matters. Investor qualification, briefing notes, and follow-through on live deals, done to the house standard.

  • New doors. A monthly rhythm of first conversations with family offices and HNWIs who are new to Paires.

  • Your development. Every investor call you shadow and every brief you write compounds into the senior version of this seat.

You are a fit if you

  • Have started building an allocator network for real, through a seat in wealth management, private banking, a family office, placement, or your own hustle, and can show relationships you opened yourself.

  • Can explain your method. How you find the right investors, how you earn the first conversation, and how you stay useful to them after it.

  • Know what your investors actually do with their money, and ideally that includes direct allocations into US startups.

  • Listen more than you pitch. Allocators trust you because you never waste their time, and you would rather lose a meeting than force one.

  • Treat discretion as a reflex. Names, allocations, and conversations stay confidential, always.

  • Work like it's 2026. AI tooling runs your pipeline and prep, so your hours go to people.

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid. A senior team to learn the craft from, live deal flow from week one, and a seat that grows into managing your own side of the network.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (SWE/Product)
jobs.description:
About Aptura

We build the evaluation datasets and RL environments that make AI reliable in domains where mistakes are expensive: finance, healthcare, and legal. Our team designs expert-curated training data, calibrated rubrics, and verifiable task environments for AI labs and startups pushing the frontier of what models can do in regulated industries.

We're a small, lean, London based team that moves fast and takes the work seriously. Everyone contributes directly. Initiative is rewarded, and ownership is the default. If you want to shape how frontier AI learns to operate in the real world, we'd like to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Member of Technical Staff on our Software Engineering team, you will build the platform that powers how Aptura operates and scales — the annotation tooling, workflow systems, quality control pipelines, and internal infrastructure that sit behind every dataset and environment we ship.

Day to day, that looks like: designing expert task creation flows, building task assignment and review interfaces, writing the data pipelines that move outputs from domain experts into structured training sets, and integrating LLM-powered tooling directly into the product. Some days it's product engineering. Some days it's closer to infrastructure. The common thread is that the software you build is what lets a small team produce high-quality evaluation data at scale.

You'll be the person who makes the platform real. Decide what gets built, how it gets built, and set the standard for how we build as we grow.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the core data annotation and workflow platform end to end — from task assignment and expert interfaces to quality control and dataset delivery

  • Design systems that support expert onboarding, task routing, review workflows, and QA at scale

  • Build and improve AI-integrated pipelines across the platform, including LLM-assisted annotation, automated checking, and model-in-the-loop workflows

  • Work directly with founders and domain operators to turn manual, bespoke processes into reliable, scalable software

  • Make strong product and engineering decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving situations — scoping, prioritising, and shipping without waiting for perfect specs

  • Help define how we build as a team: tooling choices, engineering standards, and product direction

Who We're Looking For

You will not be a good fit if you thrive in well-defined scopes and prefer a clear spec before moving. We are looking for people who are comfortable identifying what needs building, making a call, and shipping — often before the full picture is clear.

You will not be a good fit if you like to go deep on one technical area for an extended period. We are looking for people who are energised by moving across product, infrastructure, data systems, and AI tooling — sometimes all in the same week.

You will not be a good fit if you prefer to hand work off at the boundaries of your role. We are looking for people who want to own problems end to end, from the first conversation through to something live.

You will not be a good fit if you aren't yet integrating AI into how you build day to day. We are looking for people who are already using LLMs and coding agents as part of how they work, and are excited to push that further.

You will not be a good fit if you think of speed and quality as things you trade off against each other. We are looking for people who don't cut corners — they cut scope.

We don't care about background, experience, or prestige. We want people who can demonstrate they will work hard, learn fast, and ship things that matter. Former founders, early engineers at startups, and people with infrastructure experience are a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building internal tools, annotation platforms, workflow software, or operations-heavy products

  • Familiarity with modern product stacks: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, FastAPI, or similar

  • Exposure to AI products, LLM tooling, or evaluation workflows

  • Domain interest in finance, healthcare, or legal

  • Previous experience as an early or founding engineer

On-site in London. Compensation (salary + equity) will be competitive.

jobs.title: Vi søker miljøterapeuter til  oppsøkende arbeid i et flerkulturelt Oslo sentrum
jobs.description:
Uteseksjonen er en del av Storbytjenesteavdelingen i Velferdsetaten, og er Oslo kommunes oppsøkende tjeneste i Oslo sentrum.

Vi oppnår resultater gjennom systematisk feltarbeid, kontakt- og tillitsskapende arbeid samt oppfølging av enkeltpersoner i alle aldre. Videreformidling til og samarbeid med nettverk og øvrig hjelpeapparat er viktige oppgaver, og dokumentasjon vektlegges. 

Uteseksjonen tilbyr hasjavvennings-program (HAP), lavterskel psykologtjenester, koordineringsfunksjon for rus- og kriminalitetsforebyggende arbeid i sentrum (SaLTo), styrket innsats gjennom koordinerende tillitspersoner og sysselsettingstilbud til unge under 25 år som ikke får eget tilbud i bydel. Vi benytter erfaringskompetanse sammen med fagkompetanse som en integrert del av tjenesten.

En av stillingene inngår i Uteseksjonens generelle og systematiske oppsøkende arbeid i Oslo sentrum i kombinasjon med drift av vår Rådgivningstjeneste. Arbeidet organiseres i turnus med dag- og kveldsvakter. Vi ønsker snarlig tiltredelse i denne stillingen. Den andre inngår i Uteseksjonens generelle feltarbeid med turnus med dag og kveldsvakter samt arbeid hver 4. helg. Det er ønskelig med tiltredelse fra januar 2027 i denne. 

Uteseksjonen er sertifisert som Regnbuefyrtårn og har gjennomført grundig kompetanseheving i kjønns- og seksualitetsmangfold for å fremme likeverdige tjenester og et  trygt arbeidsmiljø. For at personalgruppen skal speile mangfoldet i Oslo oppfordrer vi menn og personer med minoritetsbakgrunn å søke. 

Hvis du motiveres av dette meningsfulle og givende samfunnsoppdraget, håper vi å høre fra deg!


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Miljøterapeuten vil ha særskilt ansvar for drift av rådgivningstjenesten, i tillegg til oppsøkende feltarbeid i gjeldende turnus
  • Oppgavene knyttet til drift av rådgivningstjenesten innebærer løpende koordinering av patruljer og oppfølgingsansvar for akutt/kortvarig oppfølging, rapportering og dokumentasjon, samarbeid og støtte til bydel i samarbeid med ledelse og øvrige ansatte
  • Delta og støtte opp under tjenestens arbeid med fag- og kompetanseutvikling
  • Ansvar for at arbeidsoppgavene blir utført i samsvar med virksomhetens mandat, mål, budsjett, fullmakter, lover, forskrifter og retningslinjer
  • Sørge for aktiv brukermedvirkning i utøvelse av tjenesten
  • Faglig dokumentasjon og kunnskapsformidling
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fullført bachelorgrad som barnevernspedagog, sosionom eller vernepleier. Ansatte med annen relevant utdanning på minimum bachelornivå og god kjennskap til og erfaring fra Oslo kommunes hjelpeapparat overfor unge og voksne samt spesialisthelsetjenestens tilbud kan i noen tilfeller vurderes
  • Relevant videreutdanning og/eller mastergrad er en fordel
  • Egenerfaring fra kontakt med hjelpeapparatet kan være en fordel
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk tilsvarende minimum B2 i henhold til Det felles europeiske rammeverket for språk
  • Gode evner til å organisere og prioritere oppgaver i tråd med Uteseksjonens mandat
  • God forståelse av hvordan kommunale tjenester og øvrig hjelpeapparat er organisert, og evne til å se vår tjeneste i sammenheng med dette
  • Gode IKT-ferdigheter og erfaring med Office 365; Outlook, Sharepoint, Teams, m.m, samt i felles fagsystemer som KONTAKT, GAT. WebSak+, EQS og HR-Web 
  • Førerkort klasse B er en fordel
  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest kreves for tilsetting og må fremlegges før tiltredelse

Vi ber deg legge ved vitnemål og dokumentasjon på relevant arbeidserfaring sammen med søknad innen søknadsfristen. Søkere med utenlandsk utdanning må også legge ved generell godkjenning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.

Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er en holdningssterk og handlekraftig medarbeider som kan håndtere oppsøkende sosialt arbeid både på individ-, gruppe- og systemnivå i en flerkulturell storby
  • Du har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • God fysisk helse er nødvendig for å kunne utføre systematisk feltarbeid på en sikker og effektiv måte gjennom fast patruljearbeid i utsatte miljø ute i Oslo sentrum 
  • Du evner å oppnå resultat gjennom å jobbe strukturert og prosessorientert i en fleksibel yrkesrolle
  • Du er nysgjerrig, ressurs- og prosessorientert, fleksibel, kreativ og nytenkende med en tro på at endring er mulig for alle
  • Du deler, byr på deg selv og gjør andre rundt deg gode
  • Du reflekterer over egen yrkesutøvelse og tilpasser innsatsen til brukernes behov og muligheter
  • Du bidrar og bygger opp under tjenestens interne fag- og arbeidsmiljø
  • Vi vektlegger personlig egnethet og god relasjonskompetanse i rekrutteringen av nye medarbeidere 
Vi tilbyr
  • Et spennende, mangfoldig og utfordrende fagmiljø innen et fagfelt i stadig endring
  • Engasjerte medarbeidere og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Uteseksjonen har ulike veiledningsordninger, og vi benytter reflekterende team for å utvikle reflekterte praktikere og øke faglig bevissthet
  • Faglig påfyll gjennom fagdager, kurs og kompetanseheving i Velferdsetaten
  • Gode tjenestepensjons- forsikrings- og låneordninger i  Oslo pensjonsforsikring - Som ansatt i Oslo Kommune betaler arbeidsgiver i tillegg hele pensjonspremien din etter nettolønnsordningen, dvs. at det ikke trekkes 2 % av din brutto lønn til pensjonsinnskudd
  • Lønnsplassering i lønnstrinn 29 - 41 (pt. kr 592 700,- til kr 714 100,- pr. år) samt turnustillegg i Oslo kommunes regulativ, avhengig av ansiennitet

 

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

KontaktinformasjonNoordjan Svedin Fronth, Teamleder, 415 71 968
Mette Tron, teamleder, 900 20 243
Børge Erdal, seksjonssjef, 913 40 462
ArbeidsstedMaridalsveien 3
0178 Oslo
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo kommune

Referansenr.: 5144948532
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 18.08.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

På vegne av kommunen gir Velferdsetaten tjenester til innbyggere med rusavhengighet, bidrar til et tryggere sentrum og forvalter sosiale og økonomiske boligvirkemidler. Vi har ansvar for kommunens satsing innen mangfold og inkludering og har flere tiltak for å få flere i arbeid. Vi har kriminalitetsforebyggende tiltak, forvalter store tilskuddsordninger, og vi bistår NAV og bydeler med tall og analyser. Vi er ca. 1050 ansatte fordelt på rundt 35 tjenestesteder i tillegg til administrasjonen.

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

Les mer om Velferdsetaten på www.oslo.kommune.no/etater-foretak-og-ombud/velferdsetaten/

jobs.title: Head of Strategic Product Development (all genders)
jobs.description:
The Role (What’s in the Box)

Our Nordic Product team shapes the meals, assortment and new concepts that customers experience every week across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

As Head of Strategic Product Development, you will shape and drive HelloFresh Nordics' physical product vision in close partnership with the Product Director. You'll balance two lenses: an outside-in view, tracking how our industry and competitors are evolving and how customer tastes and needs are shifting more broadly, and an inside-out view, grounded in how our own product and assortment are actually performing and what our existing customers are telling us. Bringing these together, you'll build a roadmap in close partnership with Marketing, so our biggest product bets and go-to-market efforts move as one.

Beyond setting direction, you'll own execution — leading cross-functional initiatives, scaling our assortment innovation program, and commercially managing our monetised product portfolio. The team you'll lead is still young, so a significant part of this role is building it: shaping its structure, its processes, and the way it works with stakeholders across the business, turning it into a mature, reliable engine for product strategy in the Nordics.

What You’ll Do (The Recipe)

Strategic product roadmap — building & execution

    Own the view of what our physical product should look like, grounded both in an outside-in read of industry, competitor, and customer trends, and in a solid understanding of how our existing product and assortment are performing and what our current customers tell us through feedback
    Identify, assess, and quantify strategic opportunities to evolve the product and grow the business profitably
    Co-shape the overall product strategy in close partnership with the Product Director
    Align the roadmap tightly with Marketing, so that our big bets are jointly defined and brought to customers as a single, coherent play to drive acquisition and retention
    Anchor the roadmap with other key stakeholders, including Operations and the International Product team
    Lead the execution of cross-functional strategic initiatives.

Assortment innovation strategy & execution

    Own the assortment innovation program: identify and develop new concepts, seasonal and thematic offerings, and limited-time offers.
    Coordinate execution and implementation of new concepts across Menu Planning, Recipe & Ingredient Development, and Marketing

Monetised product — commercial & operational ownership

    Manage and optimise the performance of our monetised products
    Own the commercial results (average order value (AOV) and profit contribution) and operational execution of this portfolio.

Team building & ways of working

    Shape and structure a still-young team so it can deliver reliably — Define clear roles, priorities and ways of working so the team can deliver reliably
    Build robust processes with key stakeholders (Marketing, Menu Planning, Operations, International Product) so cross-functional work runs smoothly rather than on an ad hoc basis.

What You’ll Bring (Your Ingredients)

    You bring relevant experience—typically 5–10 years—in FMCG, consumer products, management consulting or a similar field.
    You have proven experience directly managing and developing a team.
    A hands-on player-coach: as comfortable doing the strategic and analytical work yourself as you are developing and directing a team
    Genuinely curious about consumer and food trends and the competitive landscape, while equally grounded in what our existing product performance and customer feedback are telling us
    Comfortable building team structure and processes from a fairly blank slate, not just running an established machine
    Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align Product, Marketing, Operations, and international counterparts around a shared plan
    Excellent business acumen: able to identify, quantify, and business-case strategic opportunities
    Working language is English; proficiency in Swedish, Danish, or Norwegian is a plus; knowledge and understanding of Scandinavian food culture and consumers is a strong plus

Team & Location

You'll report directly to the Product Director, Nordics, and lead a team of 2 Product Managers and 1 Senior Product Strategy Manager. The role covers Denmark, Sweden and Norway and is based in our Copenhagen office.

What We Offer (The Toppings)

    HelloFresh Discounts – Enjoy 65% off your HelloFresh Meal Box and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
    Learning and Development – Make the most of a dedicated Learning & Development budget and the HelloMint mentorship program.
    Receive 25 days of paid vacation per year, + 5 days of feriefridage. Paid leave also provided for your child’s first sick day.
    Parent Benefits – Benefit from a Parental Leave policy supporting your family needs.
    Compensation and Perks – Includes a 5% company-paid pension and insurance package.
    Health – Access to Spill online therapy, available within 24 hours of request.
    Daily Comforts – Office perks include drinks and snacks, subsidized catered lunches, and breakfast every Friday.
    Fitness and Well-being – Discounts at SATS gym, plus access to sports and exercise clubs.

Are you the missing ingredient?

If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Analysis Engineer to Beyond Gravity Linköping
jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​



About Beyond Gravity

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com



Your crew

You will become part of the Dispenser organization. Today, we are a team of approximately 60 people with diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise, such as Design Engineer, System Engineer, Analysis Engineer, and Verification and Test Engineer. Together, we form a strong team with a great passion for technology – we are responsible for the development, design, structural analysis, and testing of our products. Alongside us, you will help transform and refine our ways of working within an innovative industry full of endless improvement opportunities. We are currently in an exciting transformation where we are growing a Tech Hub in Portugal and you will become part of a dedicated team with the ambition to revolutionize space!



Your mission



•  Perform structural analyses by independently conducting static strength and dynamic simulations with minimal supervision, applying relevant industry standards and engineering best practices.

•  Execute engineering calculations using hand methods to size components and validate or cross-check numerical analysis results.

•  Conduct advanced CAE simulations by performing finite element analysis (FEA) on complex systems and multi-physics problems, defining effective modeling strategies, and balancing accuracy with computational efficiency.

•  Develop and enhance analysis tools by designing automation frameworks and leading the creation of custom solutions for model setup, simulation execution, and result interpretation.

•  Collaborate across disciplines by integrating inputs from various engineering domains into structural analyses and working closely with subject matter experts to ensure consistency and accuracy.

•  Support testing activities by contributing to test planning, predicting structural behavior, assisting with sensor placement and load case definition, and correlating simulation results with physical test data.

•  Provide production and quality support by participating in Non-Conformance Review Boards (NRBs), proposing technical solutions, supporting root cause analysis, and contributing to First Article Inspections (FAI) and operator training when required.

•  Prepare technical documentation and reports by independently producing high-quality deliverables, maintaining traceability between requirements and outputs, and clearly communicating project status to stakeholders.

•  Drive problem-solving and decision-making by applying structured methodologies, evaluating evidence, identifying biases, and making sound technical decisions while considering cost, schedule, and business constraints.

•  Contribute to innovation and R&D by gathering and interpreting data, participating in brainstorming sessions, applying research methodologies, and leveraging lessons learned to improve engineering solutions.

•  Support business development activities by contributing technical inputs to bids, proposals, Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs), and Contract Change Notices (CCNs).

•  Mentor and support team development by assisting in training material creation, coaching junior engineers and interns, and supporting onboarding activities.

•  Manage tasks and project progress by tracking budgets and milestones, identifying risks and blockers, and ensuring efficient allocation of resources.

•  Support product development and lifecycle activities by maintaining knowledge of the product portfolio, interacting with hardware, and contributing to continuous product improvement initiatives.



Your story



Must’s:

•  B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Aerospace, Mechanical or other engineering, or equivalent experience.

•  3+ years of analysis experience in aerospace or equivalent industry.

•  Proficiency in FEA tools and standard analysis workflows (MSC Nastran, Hyperworks, NX, Abaqus).

•  Experience in linear static and dynamic analysis.

•  Experience in writing technical documentation.

•  Basic scripting (Python/VBA) for analysis automation.



Nice to have’s:

•  Knowledge of detailed stress analysis using aerospace methodologies.

•  Knowledge of mechanical layout of aerospace structures and materials.

•  Familiarity with nonlinear analysis.



Why Beyond Gravity



•  To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.

•  You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!

•  We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!

•  Overtime and travel compensation and you have the right to 25 days of vacation/year.

•  Wellness allowance of 3000 SEK/year via the benefits portal Epassi.

•  Lunch subsidy via Edenred, which means you are offered a card loaded with 1520 SEK/month



🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. Propel your career to new heights by applying before 30/06/2026. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​

​

Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​
