jobs.title: Leasing Manager
jobs.description:
Haluatko vastata kokonaisvaltaisesti laadukkaasta vuokraustoiminnasta ja vaikuttaa suoraan kiinteistöjen käyttöasteeseen ja tuottoon?

Taitokaari Oy etsii Tampereelle kokenutta, kaupallista ja erittäin järjestelmällistä **Leasing Manageria** vastaamaan yhtiön omistamien asuntojen, toimistojen ja muiden toimitilojen vuokrauksesta Pirkanmaan alueella.

Tehtävässä yhdistyvät aktiivinen vuokraus, riskienhallinta, asiakaspalvelu sekä laadukas dokumentointi.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu**

- asuntojen, toimistojen ja muiden tilojen vuokraus alusta loppuun

- vuokrausilmoitusten laatiminen ja markkinointi

- yhteydenottojen käsittely sekä asunto- ja toimitilanäyttöjen järjestäminen

- vuokralaisehdokkaiden arviointi ja vuokrasopimusten valmistelu

- avainten luovutukset, muutto- ja kuntotarkastukset

- vuokralaisten asiakaspalvelu ja reklamaatioiden käsittely

- viikoittainen raportointi sekä vuokrauskannan seuranta

- osallistuminen tarvittaessa myös yhtiön omien kohteiden myyntiprosesseihin


**Odotamme sinulta**

- vähintään 2–3 vuoden kokemusta vuokrauksesta, kiinteistönvälityksestä tai kiinteistöalalta

- näyttöjä itsenäisesti hoidetuista vuokrausprosesseista

- kaupallista työotetta ja kykyä viedä asiat määrätietoisesti maaliin

- erinomaista suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa

- hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia (Word, Excel ja sähköiset järjestelmät)

- ajokorttia sekä mahdollisuutta liikkua kohteiden välillä (oma auto on etu)

- joustavuutta työskennellä myös iltaisin ja lauantaisin asunto- ja toimitilanäyttöjen vuoksi

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa ja ajantasaisia it-taitoja


LKV- tai LVV-pätevyys katsotaan erittäin vahvaksi eduksi, mutta tehtävään voidaan valita myös kokenut vuokrausalan ammattilainen ilman tutkintoa.

**Arvostamme erityisesti**

Etsimme henkilöä, joka ajattelee kiinteistönomistajan näkökulmasta. Olet myynnillinen, mutta teet vuokralaisvalinnat aina huolellisesti ja objektiivisesti. Työskentelet järjestelmällisesti, dokumentoit huolellisesti ja pidät useat samanaikaiset prosessit hallinnassa. Olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, mutta tarvittaessa myös jämäkkä ja johdonmukainen.

**Palkkaus**

- kiinteä kuukausipalkka 2 500 €

- lisäksi tulospohjainen vuokraus-, myynti- ja laatuprovisio

- kokonaisansiot tyypillisesti **3 500–5 000 €/kk**.


Työ sisältää toimisto- ja kenttätyötä sekä säännöllisesti ilta- ja lauantaityötä. Asuntonäyttöjä järjestetään pääosin arki-iltaisin klo 16–20 sekä lauantaisin klo 10–18 asiakkaiden aikataulujen mukaisesti.

Hakuprosessiin kuuluu strukturoitu haastattelu, käytännön työnäyte, pätevyyksien tarkastaminen sekä vähintään kahden ammatillisen suosittelijan tarkistaminen.

**Mitä me teemme?**

**Taitokaari Oy** on vuonna 1993 perustettu vakavarainen, yksityinen suomalainen kiinteistösijoitus- ja kehityskonserni. Päätoimipaikkamme sijaitsee Tampereella, ja toimintamme kattaa laajasti Pirkanmaan, pääkaupunkiseudun sekä muut Suomen keskeiset kasvukeskukset. Meillä pääset osaksi asiantuntevaa tiimiä, joka luo kestävää arvoa rakennettuun ympäristöön.

Toimintamme jakautuu kolmeen vahvaan tukijalkaan:

- **Kiinteistösijoittaminen:** Omistamme ja vuokraamme laadukkaita asuin- ja liikekiinteistöjä.

- **Hankekehitys ja rakentaminen:** Jalostamme ja kehitämme kiinteistöjä niiden koko elinkaaren ajan aina ideasta valmiiksi kohteeksi.

- **Sijoituspalvelut:** Tarjoamme sijoittajakumppaneillemme luotettavia ja ammattimaisesti johdettuja kiinteistösijoitusmahdollisuuksia.


**Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?**

- **Vakaus ja pitkäjänteisyys:** Olemme toimineet alalla menestyksekkäästi jo yli kolme vuosikymmentä. Meillä työskentelet turvallisessa ja taloudellisesti vakaassa ympäristössä.

- **Monipuoliset ja vastuulliset tehtävät:** Kiinteistöjen koko elinkaaren hallinta tarkoittaa, että pääset vaikuttamaan mielenkiintoisiin ja vaihteleviin hankkeisiin.

- **Yhteisöllinen kulttuuri:** Arvostamme ammattitaitoa, avoimuutta ja yhdessä tekemistä. Meillä jokaisen panoksella on merkitystä.


**Kiinnostuitko?** Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen mahdollisimman pian viimeistään 16.8.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikumppanimme Reija Laurell (0405244096, reija.laurell@hrwithyou.fi).

jobs.title: Erityisasiantuntija (asiakaspäällikkö) | Oikeusrekisterikeskus
jobs.description:
**Haluatko päästä kehittämään asiakkuuksia ja edistämään yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävien organisaatioiden digitalisaatiota? Tule meille asiakaspäälliköksi!**

**Työtehtävän kuvaus**

Haemme asiakaspäällikköä Oikeusrekisterikeskuksen asiakkuustiimiin sidosryhmäpalveluihin. Toimit nimettyjen asiakkaiden ensisijaisena yhteyshenkilönä ja vastaat heidän palveluidensa kokonaisvaltaisesta kehittämisestä. Edistät asiakkaiden siirtymää perinteisistä IT-ratkaisuista kohti moderneja digitaalisia palvelukokonaisuuksia. Kehität asiakkuuksia pitkäjänteisesti, varmistat palveluiden laadun ja taloudellisuuden sekä huolehdit siitä, että ne vastaavat asiakkaiden tarpeita. Tunnet asiakkaasi toimintaympäristön ja toimit aktiivisena kumppanina heidän digikehityksessään. Tunnistat kehitysmahdollisuuksia, tuot niitä esiin ja viet niitä eteenpäin yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

Tehtävässä yhdistyvät asiakkuuksien kehittäminen ja palvelukokonaisuuksien tavoitteellinen ohjaus. Digikehityksen edistämisen lisäksi vastaat asiakkuuksien suunnittelusta, ennakoinnista ja taloudellisesta seurannasta osana vaikuttavaa ja kestävää palvelukokonaisuutta.

Tehtävässä vastaat muun muassa:

- Asiakkuussuunnitelmien laatimisesta ja ylläpidosta asiakkuudenhoitomallin mukaisesti

- Asiakkaiden digisuunnitelmien omistajuudesta ja kehitysehdotusten edistämisestä

- Taloudellisesta suunnittelusta: budjetoinnista, ennustamisesta ja raportoinnista

- Asiakastyytyväisyyden kehittämisestä ja sidosryhmäyhteistyön vahvistamisesta


Toimit osana asiakkuustiimiä, johon kuuluu neljä muuta asiakaspäällikköä sekä asiakkuusjohtaja. Jokaisella on vastuullaan omat nimetyt asiakkaansa oikeusministeriön hallinnonalalta . Asiakaspäälliköt tekevät tiivistä yhteistyötä, tukevat toistensa työtä ja tapaavat säännöllisesti joko etäyhteyksin tai kasvotusten. Lisäksi teet tiivistä yhteistyötä sekä asiakkaiden, ORK:n eri yksiköiden että palvelutuotannon kumppaneiden kanssa.

Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden edistää asiakkaiden digikehitystä yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävällä toimialalla. Pääset verkostoitumaan laajasti oikeusministeriön hallinnonalan sekä muiden kumppaneidemme kanssa. Oikeusrekisterikeskuksessa arvostamme yhteistyötä, jatkuvaa kehittämistä ja uuden oppimista.

**Kielitaitovaatimukset**

Suomi

- Suullinen osaaminen: Erinomainen

- Kirjallinen osaaminen: Erinomainen

- Ymmärtäminen: Erinomainen


Tehtävässä tarvittava muu kielitaito

Englanti

- Suullinen osaaminen: Hyvä

- Kirjallinen osaaminen: Hyvä

- Ymmärtäminen: Hyvä


Ruotsi

- Suullinen osaaminen: Tyydyttävä

- Kirjallinen osaaminen: Tyydyttävä

- Ymmärtäminen: Tyydyttävä


**Hakijalta odotamme**

Sinulla on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto ja vahva kokemus ja osaaminen asiakkuudenhoidosta tai vastaavista tehtävistä. Olet voinut työskennellä esimerkiksi konsultoinnissa, julkisella sektorilla tai IT-alalla. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta: IT-palvelutuotannon tuntemusta, mukaan lukien keskeiset toimintatavat ja yhteistyöverkostot Ymmärrystä tietojärjestelmistä sekä niiden yhteyksistä ja riippuvuuksista Aitoa halua ja kykyä kehittää asiakassuhteita pitkäjänteisesti Kokemusta projektinjohtamisesta ja suunnittelutyömenetelmien hallintaa Työskentelytaitoihin liittyen odotamme sinulta:

- kokonaisvaltaista ajattelukykyä erityisesti palveluiden ja toimintamallien kehittämisessä

- oma-aloitteista, ratkaisukeskeistä ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta

- viihdyt vaihtelevassa ja monipuolisessa roolissa, jossa asiakastyön ja kehittämisen rinnalla korostuvat suunnittelu, ennakointi ja raportointi.

- erinomaisia viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä vaikuttaa ja neuvotella

- hyviä päätöksenteko- ja organisointitaitoja


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme kattavan työterveyshuollon, joustavat hybridityömahdollisuudet, lounastuen, kulttuuri- ja liikuntasetelit sekä laajan koulutustarjonnan.

**Selvitykset**

Virkaan tai tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä voidaan tehdä hakijan suostumuksella henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014).

Turvallisuusselvitysmenettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy tarkempia tietoja osoitteessa www.supo.fi.

**Yhteystietomme**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa asiakkuusjohtaja Tami Koivuniemi, puh. +358 295 665 833, ke 15.7. klo 9–10 ja to 16.7. 14–15.

Lisäksi lisätietoja antaa yhteistyökumppanimme MPS:n seniorikonsultti Annina Ahlroth. Hänet tavoittaa puhelimitse ma 10.8. klo 15–16, puh. +358 20 746 9519.

**Hakemuksen lähettäminen**

Toivomme hakemukset ensisijaisesti sähköisinä Valtiolle.fi-palvelun kautta. Voit kuitenkin hakea tätä työpaikkaa myös toimittamalla hakemuksesi kirjaamon postiosoitteeseen.

**Tehtävän tiedot**

**Lisätietoja:**

- Arvostamme yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuolia olevia ja eri taustoista tulevia henkilöitä.

- Tehtävän taso: Asiantuntijataso

- Etätyön kuvaus: Tehtävän virkapaikka on Hämeenlinna, mutta meillä on työntekijöitä ympäri Suomen. Hybridityömallimme sisältää paikkariippumattoman etätyön sekä lähikohtaamisia työkavereiden, asiakkaiden ja verkostojen kanssa. Huomioimmekin ORK:ssa joustavasti henkilöstömme erilaiset elämäntilanteet.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 3 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Business Controller, Operations
jobs.description:
Help drive business performance in Finland's leading healthcare company

We are looking for an analytical, proactive and business-minded Business Controller, Operations to join Terveystalo's Healthcare Services Business Controlling team.

In this role, you will take ownership of the financial performance management of your own geographical areas. Working closely with business unit directors, you will support business performance through financial analysis, reporting and actionable insights.

As part of a team of three business controllers, you will have your own areas of responsibility while working closely together with your colleagues, sharing knowledge and supporting each other in developing both the business and the finance function.

The position reports to the Director, Business Control. We offer you a full-time permanent position.

Your key responsibilities

Partner with the business

- Act as the finance business partner for your designated geographical areas
- Support Business Unit Directors with financial insight and decision support
- Participate in regular business performance reviews and help identify opportunities and improvement areas
- Prepare business case calculations and provide financial guidance for operational decisions

Drive business performance

- Prepare monthly reporting and performance analyses
- Support budgeting and forecasting processes
- Monitor costs, profitability and business performance
- Perform month-end controlling activities, including accruals and financial follow-up
- Deliver high-quality ad hoc analyses and management materials

Develop ways of working

- Contribute to the continuous development of business controlling, reporting and finance processes
- Support the development and utilization of reporting tools, including Qlik Sense
- Explore new ways of working and leverage technologies, including AI, to improve efficiency and create value

What will make you successful?

You enjoy understanding how business works and turning financial information into meaningful insights that support better decisions. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable taking ownership of your own responsibilities while collaborating closely with colleagues.

You communicate financial topics clearly to different audiences and are not afraid to ask questions, challenge assumptions or present your own views in a constructive manner.

Most importantly, you have the ambition to continuously develop yourself as a finance professional and business partner.

We hope you bring

- Master's degree in finance, economics, business administration, technology or another relevant field
- At least three years of relevant experience in business controlling or another finance business partnering role
- Experience working in medium-sized or large organizations
- Strong analytical skills and understanding of financial planning and business performance
- Solid Excel and PowerPoint skills
- Experience with reporting and analytics tools; knowledge of Qlik Sense is an advantage
- Commercial mindset and proactive approach to problem solving
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Ability to explain financial information in a clear and practical way
- Curiosity, willingness to learn and drive to continuously improve ways of working
- Fluent communication skills in Finnish and English

Previous experience in service businesses or consumer-facing industries is considered an advantage.

Why join Terveystalo?

At Terveystalo, finance is an active business partner that helps drive business performance through insight, analysis and collaboration. In this role, you will work closely with the business stakeholders, supporting decision-making and helping the business understand what drives performance.

You will join a collaborative Business Controlling team where responsibility, continuous learning and knowledge sharing go hand in hand. We encourage new ideas, support professional growth and continuously develop our tools, processes and ways of working.

We work in a hybrid model and expect you to be present at our Kamppi office two to three days per week.

Interested?

If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your application, including your salary request and earliest possible starting date, by August 16th, 2026.

For further information, please contact Johannes Grasberger, Director, Business Control +358 50 471 7723 on August 12th and 14th between 10:00-11:00.

Start the day prepared, not overwhelmed.

Maximum three items per section. Quiet days are allowed to be quiet â when there is nothing unusual, the briefing says so.

Clarity findings

Useful answers, exactly where the decision is made.

Discreet, evidence-backed findings appear on the customer, job and quote pages you already work in â and hide completely when there is nothing useful to say. No empty placeholders. No manufactured urgency.

Customer page

Job page

What happened on previous visits to the same asset, before the engineer sets off.

Quotes

Quotes that meet the agreed chase criteria, ranked deterministically â not by an algorithm's mood.

Curcle noticed.

A compact dashboard panel surfaces a handful of findings that need attention â a compliance item, a commercial item, an operational item. The ranking is deterministic, positive findings get equal standing, and it never shows more than a few things at once.

  • Two certificates approach lapse next week.
  • Three quotes meet the chase criteria.

Every answer can show its work.

  • 1 Curcle reads the records your operational work already creates.

  • 3 The finding carries its evidence, its freshness and who may see it.
  • 4 Optional plain-language phrasing makes it easier to read â and is discarded if it doesn't match the finding.
  • 5 The person remains responsible for the decision.

No AI in the finding path

Every answer linked to source records

Evidence age shown plainly

âNot enough evidenceâ is a valid answer

Visibility enforced by role and customer scope

No individual league tables

No autonomous decisions

AI assists; people decide

One evidence base. The right perspective for every role.

Each role receives only the findings and evidence they are entitled to see â enforced on the server, not by the interface.

Engineer

Office

Clarity does not pretend to know.

When there is not enough evidence, Curcle says so. âNot enough evidenceâ is a first-class answer â shown plainly, with how many records it was based on.

Honest uncertainty is more useful than a confident guess.

With the Operations Room

The Operations Room can draw on evidence-backed Clarity findings to prepare the agenda and give leaders better context. Clarity doesnât replace the meeting â decisions and actions remain human-owned.

About the role

You will focus on developing common UI components and core libraries for a large-scale netbank platform. Working within a specialized front-end team, you will support the internal developer community while tackling complex technical challenges.

You are offered
- An excellent opportunity to learn and grow professionally in a global organization
- Independent and responsible role
- Support and guidance from experienced colleagues
- A hybrid work model with up to 2 remote days per week
- Epassi lunch deduction

Work tasks

This role involves building the core UI foundation for digital banking services, ensuring high accessibility standards and supporting other developers in their implementation.
- Develop and maintain common UI components and core libraries
- Support the internal web developer community by providing technical guidance
- Identify and resolve accessibility bugs
- Implement high-quality code
- Contribute to the architectural evolution of the core web platform

We are looking for

- Suitable educational background within IT
- Fluency in English
- Some prior work experience and strong practical experience of Typescript or Javascript, HTML, CSS, and web components
- In-depth understanding of modern web frameworks such as React or Angular
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and a willingness to take ownership of tasks

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Strong team player
- Self-driven and responsible
- Intellectually curious

For at least the first 6 months, you will work on an assignment for our client in the banking industry. A credit check will be conducted for the selected individual.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Člověka, který si umí stanovit priority a rozhodovat se pod tlakem

jobs.title: Obchodní zástupce - stavební technika (plošiny, manipulátory, bagry) (M/Ž), Obchodní zástupci
jobs.description:
Pravidelné pracoviště: Myslotínská 1048, 396 01 Pelhřimov, nástup možný IHNED.

Kerouš s.r.o. je česká rodinná společnost s více než 18 letou tradicí. Patříme mezi přední dodavatele stavební techniky na Vysočině a v současné době výrazně rozšiřujeme své působení po celé České republice. Jsme výhradním partnerem značky ZOOMLION pro pracovní plošiny v České republice a na Slovensku a současně rozvíjíme další produktové řady - teleskopické manipulátory, bagry, nakladače i vysokozdvižné vozíky.

Co bude Vaší náplní práce?
aktivní vyhledávání nových zákazníků ve svěřeném regionu,
péče o stávající klienty a rozvoj dlouhodobých obchodních vztahů,
prodej pracovních plošin, teleskopických manipulátorů, bagrů a další stavební techniky,
prezentace strojů přímo u zákazníků, příprava cenových nabídek a obchodních řešení,
spolupráce se servisním oddělením při péči o zákazníky, sledování trhu, konkurence a nových obchodních příležitostí, reprezentace společnosti na výstavách, dnech otevřených dveří
a předváděcích akcích.

Koho hledáme?
Hledáme člověka, který:
má obchodního ducha a baví ho jednat s lidmi, chce vydělávat podle svých výsledků,
je samostatný, aktivní a dotahuje věci do konce, má pozitivní vztah ke stavební nebo zemědělské technice, umí budovat dlouhodobou důvěru zákazníků, nebojí se cestovat za klienty.
Výhodou jsou zkušenosti s prodejem:
stavební techniky, zemědělské techniky, manipulační techniky, nákladních vozidel nebo užitkových automobilů, případně zkušenosti z půjčoven techniky.

Co od Vás očekáváme?
minimálně středoškolské vzdělání, obchodní zkušenosti, výborné komunikační a vyjednávací schopnosti, řidičský průkaz skupiny B, uživatelskou znalost práce na PC,
vysoké pracovní nasazení a orientaci na výsledek.

Co Vám nabízíme?
Nadstandardní finanční ohodnocení, motivující fixní mzdu, vysoké provize bez horního limitu,
mimořádné odměny za obchodní výsledky, Špičkové pracovní vybavení, služební automobil
i pro soukromé účely, notebook, mobilní telefon, moderní CRM systém.
Kariérní růst
Nebudete prodávat pouze jeden výrobek.
Budete mít možnost postupně převzít odpovědnost za celé produktové skupiny:
pracovní plošiny, teleskopické manipulátory, bagry, kolové nakladače, vysokozdvižné vozíky.

Pro nejlepší obchodníky nabízíme možnost vybudovat vlastní obchodní tým a podílet se na rozvoji značky ZOOMLION v České republice.
Profesní rozvoj - pravidelná školení, zahraniční školení u výrobce, účast na evropských výstavách, možnost pracovních cest do výrobních závodů v Číně.

Benefity
Stravenky/příspěvek na stravování, pracovní oblečení, zahraniční pracovní cesty
firemní akce, bonusy/prémie, flexibilní začátek/konec pracovní doby
příspěvek na penzijní/životní připojištění, sleva na firemní výrobky/služby

Kontakt e-mailem.

jobs.description:
Company Information

CSWâs Engineered Building Solutions segment manufactures custom architectural building components and innovative firestopping and smoke-rated products that help protect people. Safety and code compliance are top of mind for architects, engineers and contractors. Our purposeful brands combine functionality with aesthetically pleasing designs for the construction, refurbishment, and modernization of buildings.â¯Our brands include Balco, Greco Architectural Metal Products, and Smoke Guard.

Position Summary

Balco is seeking a dynamic, motivated, and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to lead and grow sales of our architectural product lines across the Western Half of the United States. This is a high-impact leadership role for a sales professional who thrives in the architectural building products space and is energized by building teams, driving growth, and influencing complex construction projects from design through installation.

The RSM will lead a network of direct sales professionals and independent manufacturer representatives while serving as a key market ambassador for Balcoâs portfolio of architectural engineered products for the construction industry. Categories include expansion joint systems, stair nosings, entrance mats & grids, photoluminescent egress systems, etc. The ideal candidate combines strong sales leadership with technical acumen to guide product selection based on project-specific conditions, ensuring Balco solutions are specified and installed successfully in competitive bid environments. This role combines strategic leadership, hands-on selling and technical support, and rigorous performance management to deliver profitable growth and exceptional customer experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Drive year-over-year revenue growth to meet or exceed sales budgets across assigned territories and product lines.
  • Build, coach, and lead a high-performing sales organization consisting of direct sales employees and independent manufacturer representatives, setting clear goals and driving accountability across both groups.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to sales team members and customers, including analyzing project conditions, recommending appropriate Balco products (e.g., expansion joint systems, stair nosings, photoluminescent egress markings), and assisting with submittals and specifications.
  • Develop and implement competitive strategies to increase Balco specification rates and market share, including targeted initiatives with architects, contractors, and distributors.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of the competitive landscape, including products, pricing, and market dynamics, to win specification and project opportunities.
  • Track and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitive activities using CRM tools; prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports.â¯
  • Deliver sales and product knowledge presentations to architects, contractors, trade groups, and other stakeholders.
  • Lead and support complex negotiations to secure profitable, strategic opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Customer Service, Technical Services, and internal leadership to ensure outstanding execution and customer satisfaction.
  • Establish clear expectations, regularly track, and review performance metrics, proactively address gaps through coaching and development plans, and recognize/reward wins and best practices.
  • Expand and strengthen relationships with existing customers, contractors, distributors, architects, design engineers, and other key influencers across the full sales territory.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety requirements, including OSHA 10 standards for jobsite visits.
  • Travel to meet customers, prospects, sales team members, attend trade shows, and other industry events. Travel expectations ~30%.â¯

jobs.title: Partner Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Partner Sales Specialist to help scale Replit's strategic partnership ecosystem into a repeatable and measurable revenue channel. This role sits at the intersection of Partnerships and Enterprise Sales, serving as the execution engine behind our co-sell motions with strategic partners including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, and future ecosystem partners.

You will work directly with Account Executives, Strategic Alliances, and partner field teams to identify opportunities, coordinate co-sell engagement, accelerate deal progression, and drive measurable business outcomes through partnerships.

This is a highly collaborative and externally facing role for someone who enjoys building relationships, working directly with sales teams, and turning strategic partnerships into pipeline and revenue. You'll play a critical role in helping Replit establish partnerships as a scalable enterprise growth channel.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive enterprise co-sell motions across Replit's strategic partnerships, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, and future ecosystem partners.

 - Partner closely with Account Executives to identify opportunities where strategic partners can accelerate customer acquisition, expansion, and procurement.

 - Build trusted working relationships with partner account teams to increase co-sell engagement and opportunity progression.

 - Conduct recurring account mapping exercises with strategic partners to identify whitespace opportunities and prioritize joint engagement.

 - Coordinate partner involvement throughout the sales cycle, ensuring opportunities receive appropriate partner support and visibility.

 - Drive partner sourced and partner influenced opportunities through active coordination, follow up, and stakeholder management.

 - Manage deal registration processes across partner portals, ensuring accurate and timely submission of opportunities to maximize partner program benefits and co-sell eligibility.

 - Collaborate closely with Sales, Strategic Alliances, Partner Operations, Marketing, Enablement, and partner stakeholders to ensure successful execution of partnership initiatives.

 - Help establish repeatable co-sell processes, operating rhythms, and best practices that can scale across Replit's partner ecosystem.

 - Maintain visibility into partner engagement across active opportunities and support accurate attribution of partner sourced and partner influenced pipeline.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in enterprise sales, channel sales, partnerships, alliances, business development, partner management, or related go to market functions.

 - Experience working directly with enterprise Account Executives and sales organizations to drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.

 - Experience supporting enterprise co-sell motions with hyperscalers, cloud providers, ISVs, systems integrators, or strategic technology partners.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, opportunity management, and pipeline development.

 - Experience conducting account mapping, opportunity planning, and partner engagement activities.

 - Familiarity with deal registration processes and partner portal management across hyperscaler or ISV programs.

 - Strong relationship building skills and comfort working across both internal and external stakeholder groups.

 - Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.

 - Experience operating in fast paced, high growth environments.

 - Excellent communication, coordination, and project management skills.

 - Strong Salesforce proficiency and familiarity with CRM driven sales processes.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Familiarity with Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, or other enterprise technology ecosystems.

 - Familiarity with Azure Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, private offers, hyperscaler procurement motions, and co-sell programs.

 - Experience supporting partner sourced or partner influenced revenue motions.

 - Experience working in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, AI, or enterprise software companies.

 - Experience helping build repeatable partnership and co-sell programs from the ground up.

 - Passion for AI, developer tools, and helping enterprises transform how software gets built.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
Osatina Grupa d.o.o. je u potrazi za stručnim i motiviranim Sistem inženjerom (m/ž) koji će se pridružiti našem IT timu. Ako imaš iskustva u održavanju poslužiteljske infrastrukture, voliš rješavati tehničke izazove i želiš raditi u dinamičnom okruženju, ovo je prilika za tebe! OPIS POSLA Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:
  • virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • file serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.
UVJETI
  • minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN)
ŠTO NUDIMO
  • ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.
Kako se prijaviti? Ako prepoznaješ sebe u ovom opisu i želiš postati dio našeg tima, pošalji nam svoj životopis (CV) i kratko motivacijsko pismo na e-mail adresu: natjecaji@osatina.hr s naslovom "Prijava za posao: Sistem inženjer". Natječaj ostaje otvoren do 14.08.2026. Samo kandidati koji uđu u uži krug bit će kontaktirani. Radujemo se tvojoj prijavi!

jobs.title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.title: Technical Advisor / Principal Architect, Office of the CTO
jobs.description:
Postulation uniquement en ligne - merci de mentionner sous source (ORP)

Kandou AI is redefining the economics of AI infrastructure. Our proprietary MIMO‑over‑copper technology powers a high‑performance, chiplet‑based AI memory fabric that delivers high bandwidth and ultra‑low latency at dramatically lower power. Our architecture represents a foundational shift in how next‑generation AI hardware is built.

We are seeking a Technical Advisor / Principal Architect to work directly with the CTO on the conception, modeling, and development of breakthrough communication and interconnect technologies.

This is a rare opportunity for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of theory, architecture, and silicon implementation — someone who wants to help shape the future of chip‑to‑chip, die‑to‑die, memory, and networking interconnects.

Role Overview:
You will partner closely with the CTO to explore, evaluate, and prototype next‑generation communication system architectures. This role spans research, modeling, algorithm development, system architecture, and early‑stage silicon feasibility. You will help translate theoretical concepts into implementable designs that can scale into real products.

What You Will Do:

jobs.title: Mobile Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

 - Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

 - Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Product Engineer, New Products
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.




The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.




The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.





HOW WE WORK

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.



Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

 - Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

 - Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

 - Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

 - Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit
   
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of shipping high-quality, user-facing products

 - Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code

 - Deep experience with TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, along with strong knowledge of browser performance, application state, responsive design, and accessibility

 - Strong product judgment and visual taste, with the ability to balance usability, speed, correctness, polish, and long-term maintainability

 - Comfort working across the full stack, including Node.js, APIs, Postgres, data models, and production debugging

 - Familiarity with agentic software development and how coding agents build, test, review, and operate software
   
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Building visual editors, presentation software, creative tools, data applications, developer tools, or collaboration products

 - Working with canvas or graphics systems, rich text, direct manipulation, real-time collaboration, data visualization, or complex interactive interfaces

 - Designing user experiences around AI generation, streaming responses, tool calls, and long-running agent workflows

 - Founding a technical company, working as a founding engineer, or shipping a high-visibility independent project

These experiences are preferred, but not required. We care most about what you have built, the quality of your product thinking, and your ability to learn quickly.





EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Building on top of our Replit Slides AI-native presentation product where users can generate beautiful decks, directly edit elements, collaborate with others, and reliably export their work

 - Enable Replit Agent to turn raw datasets and natural-language questions into interactive, trustworthy data applications

 - Design visual tools that make AI-generated work feel as precise, editable, and controllable as traditionally authored content

 - Build reusable editing, visualization, collaboration, and artifact-management systems that power multiple new Replit products

 - Develop feedback loops and evaluations that improve the visual quality of Agent-generated artifacts
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

jobs.title: Expression of Interest
jobs.description:
Why we exist

We can get food, groceries and rides to our door on demand but accessing healthcare still means battling outdated systems, long waiting lists and travelling to sometimes overstretched clinical facilities.

Demand is rising, capacity in clinical settings is not coping, and patients' expectations of how they manage their health have fundamentally changed. That is why Heim exists: to build the AI layer for the last mile of healthcare, and make home the default place for patients to access care, at scale.

We surface and optimise unused practitioner availability, then work with healthcare providers to deliver care ranging from blood sample collection to wound dressing, reaching patients where and when they feel most comfortable.

About Us

We're a team of technologists, clinicians and commercial leaders with a track record of launching, scaling and exiting ventures in cloud technology and healthcare.

Before Heim, James Monico and Kelly Klifa built Testing For All, scaling the not-for-profit diagnostics provider into the go-to platform for Covid testing during the pandemic, testing over a million patients in under 18 months. Before that, James co-founded and scaled Cloudreach, exiting to Blackstone in 2017. Dr Elle Clarke, our Medical Director, is a fellow of the 2026 NHS Innovation Accelerator.

We've tripled our volume of appointments every period since going live at the end of 2023, and are backed by leading VCs in the space. We now cover 98% of the UK and hold a 4.9/5 patient rating.

Why we're asking

We're a small but mighty team and are growing quickly, which means roles open at short notice and close fast. Rather than lose good people to timing, we'd rather know who you are now. Tell us what you're interested in and we'll come back to you if and when something fits. Weâre building a picture of people across:

  • Clinical
  • Product
  • Technology
  • Growth & Commercial
  • Marketing
  • Operations & Delivery
  • HR and Finance


What We Look For, Whatever The Role

  • Extreme ownership and high velocity, paired with a real appreciation for clinical safety in a high-stakes environment
  • Low-ego collaboration across the whole organisation, engineers, commercial, clinical and implementation alike
  • Curiosity and initiative. You want to look under the hood, evaluate trade-offs and dig into the data rather than accept the first answer
  • A belief that there is beauty in simplicity, and a habit of returning to first principles on complex problems
  • A critical mind that guides the people around you towards clear decisions
  • Comfort with an unstructured, fast-moving environment, and readiness to be challenged

Each year, Audacious selects a cohort of extraordinary leaders from around the world â visionaries with proximity to the problems they're solving, and bold plans to shift systems, lift up communities, and contribute to a healthier planet.

Since its launch in 2018, Audacious has helped to catalyze more than $8B for over 70 projects across a range of issue areas. Rooted in TED's belief that ideas can come from anywhere, Audacious focuses on the strength of the idea and the team behind it, not a fixed issue area. Funded projects span science, climate, technology, health, social safety net and justice.

Job Description

Role Description

The Managing Director, Discovery and Insight leads Audacious's global search for ambitious ideas and changemakers â finding, testing, and building the case for the ideas and leaders most worth backing each funding cycle. This role owns end-to-end curation, application, and diligence activities, ultimately leading to recommendations for the cohort of finalists selected annually.

The Managing Director's work is centered on: a strategy informed by continuous learning about systems-level impact and Audacious' unique role within it; deep collaboration with applicants, donors, and partners nurtured over time; and leadership of a strong team to sustain the work.

Each year, the Discovery and Insight team conducts a global search to identify nonprofit ideas that are:

  • Innovative and offer a unique approach to a significant problem with the potential to shift the status quo or the system they operate within
  • Proximate & Community-Oriented in leadership and decision-making structure (i.e., led by those who intimately understand the problem/opportunity, incorporating impacted communities in decision-making, led by someone who has direct experience in/with the community served)
  • Approaching an inflection point or needing a significant capital inflow to catalyze a differentiated level of impact that they havenât received support for yet (rather than support for ongoing operations)
  • Thoughtfully ambitious ideas that both inspire and convince â have an exciting, breakthrough vision (âinspireâ), clear outcomes, and evidence that the idea will have a significant and concrete impact (âconvinceâ)

Key Responsibilities

  • Set and evolve the sourcing and curation strategy.
  • Advance sourcing and curation strategy for each cycle, forming a clear point of view on where Audacious should be learning, looking, collaborating, and why, ultimately carrying that strategy forward across cycles
  • Develop a âfuture-orientedâ approach by monitoring and anticipating emerging trends and innovations that Audacious actively engages with or responds to
  • Actively capture insights and lessons learned to refine and improve Audacious's sourcing and curation activities annually
  • Lead selection and diligence.
  • Apply the sourcing and curation strategy to identify the ideas most worth Audacious's attention - deciding what advances into the application stage, and bringing along multiple stakeholders and inputs along that decision-making process
  • Lead diligence on selected organizations, rigorously testing readiness, viability, and fit within Audacious's portfolio
  • Build the recommendation â evidence, rationale, and risks included â that carries an idea into finalist selection
  • Cultivate and steward the partners who bring ideas to Audacious.
  • Surface strong ideas by building genuine, ongoing relationships with social sector leaders, including funder and intermediary partners (incl. sourcing networks, collaboratives, and others)
  • Steward key partner relationships by developing a deep understanding of each stakeholderâs goals, priorities, and aspirations
  • Maintain stakeholder relationships continuously, within and across cycles, to ensure trust and rapport among all actors
  • Represent Audacious's point of view in the field, using that standing to draw the most ambitious organizations and ideas toward the platform and to create richer opportunities for sector collaboration
  • Build and nurture a team that explores the frontier of audacious social change.
  • Lead the Discovery and Insight vertical and its resourcing strategically, matching capacity to where the real work sits and bringing in the right technical expertise when needed
  • Develop people who can source, diligence, and hold partner relationships credibly in their own right â building a team of strong practitioners so Audacious's discovery capacity grows beyond any single person
  • Effectively steward relationships and actively collaborate with key Audacious partners (e.g., The Bridgespan Group) with whom we partner year-round

Qualifications

Career and Functional Experience

Essential

  • A leader who has set strategy in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments, and who can hold their own in rooms both with ultra-high net worth individuals and issue experts and with their own team, making consequential decisions grounded in clear principles and with conviction
  • Strong generalist fluency across geographic, social-change and innovation domains with the maturity and credibility to engage experts across them
  • Experience building and developing teams, leading change management efforts, and operating through influence across a senior leadership group
  • Access to, and standing within, networks across the social-change and social-innovation ecosystem

Strongly Preferred

  • Familiarity with multiple models across the sector â funder-collaborative platforms and other philanthropic sourcing and investment mechanisms
  • Experience in multinational and culturally diverse organizations

Personal Characteristics / Culture Fit

  • Strong mission orientation, high integrity leadership, alignment with Audaciousâ values
  • Creative, team-oriented, and collaborative, willing to pitch in where needed
  • Intellectually curious; a quick study who stays current on social change and emerging trends in philanthropy, and can lead on ways to evolve our work
  • Confident without certainty; decisive without rigidity
  • Judgment to lead through influence rather than ownership

What Success Looks Like

  • A strategy that evolves as the world does â growing sharper and more grounded cycle over cycle â because someone owns its development and can hold key decisions steady even when stakeholder interests pull in different directions
  • A clear, evolving sense of what belongs in Audacious's portfolio â built from what selection and diligence have taught, not assumed upfront
  • A network of donors and partners who stay engaged and where relationships are nurtured from inception, and where trust, learning, and respect are built over time
  • Recommendations reaching the Executive Director hold up because the diligence, learning, and collaboration behind them are real and rigorous

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
Help grow an independent magazine dedicated to investigative journalism, culture and ideas.


Clandestine Magazine is looking for a Social Media Manager on a part-time voluntary basis to help grow our social media presence and introduce our work to new audiences.


We are an independent volunteer-led publication covering the stories, ideas and cultural movements shaping our world. 


We are not a conventional magazine. Our editorial landscape spans 12 topics â

Affairs â World Affairs, Cities, Environment, Philosophy, Politics and the Progressive World.

Culture â Art, Fashion, Film, Literature, Music and Technology.


Alongside our core features, we publish investigative reporting, immersive gonzo journalism, long-form essays and showcase emerging artists.


As a volunteer-led publication, we're building something with purpose. Beyond journalism, we also support charitable initiatives including a community kitchen and projects supporting people experiencing homelessness.


The Role

You'll take ownership of our social media strategy and help build a distinctive, recognisable presence that reflects the quality of our journalism and creative work.

Responsibilities include:

  • Developing and executing an Instagram & Tiktok content strategy.
  • Creating engaging posts, carousels, stories and reels.
  • Planning and maintaining a content calendar.
  • Writing compelling captions aligned with our editorial voice.
  • Growing our audience organically through community engagement.
  • Identifying trends while maintaining our editorial identity.
  • Working with editors, writers and artists to showcase new features and projects.
  • Monitoring performance and suggesting ways to improve reach and engagement.


We're Looking For Someone Who

  • Has experience managing or growing an Instagram account (personal, professional or voluntary).
  • Has a strong eye for design, storytelling and visual presentation.
  • Understands what performs well on Instagram and Tiktok without relying on clickbait.
  • Is interested in journalism, culture, current affairs or the creative industries.
  • Is proactive, reliable and enjoys taking initiative.
  • Can commit a few hours each week.


What You'll Gain

  • A key leadership role within an ambitious independent publication.
  • Creative freedom to shape our social media strategy.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with writers, editors and artists from around the world.
  • Portfolio-building experience with published work and measurable growth.


About Clandestine


Explore the world â 12 topics.


Clandestine Magazine is an independent publication dedicated to investigative journalism, the cultural zeitgeist and the ideas shaping our time.


We believe in rigorous reporting, thoughtful storytelling and publishing work that is both intellectually engaging and thought-provoking. Our pages bring together investigative features, long-form essays and distinctive voices from around the world.


We are not a conventional magazine. Our editorial landscape spans 12 topics â


Affairs â World Affairs, Cities, Environment, Philosophy, Politics and the Progressive World.


Culture â Art, Fashion, Film, Literature, Music and Technology.


Alongside our core editorial, we publish 'Injustices', examining global issues, overlooked stories and the realities that often escape the headlines. 'Gonzo' features immersive, first-hand reporting, offering deeply personal perspectives on people, places and experiences, while 'Essays' provides a home for considered long-form writing and original thought. Creativity is equally central to Clandestine, and through our 'Your Art Here' section, we offer emerging and established artists a place to showcase their work, celebrating originality and the creative voices that shape the creative disciplines of today.


Beyond publishing, we are committed to supporting charitable initiatives that help those facing hardship. Kindness, compassion and respect for others remain central to our ethos, shaping both our work and the community we continue to build. We work alongside registered charities and currently run two of our own initiatives â a community kitchen providing support for those in need, and a 'Tap for the Homeless' scheme, offering a simple way to provide essential assistance to people experiencing homelessness.


More than a magazine, Clandestine is a collective of curious minds, writers, artists and readers brought together by a shared appreciation for thoughtful journalism and culture.

jobs.title: Directeur-rice Centre Les Jonquilles - Xonrupt-Longemer (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

jobs.title: Pakettiautohuolto -franchisingyrittäjä Tampereelle
jobs.description:
Pakettiautohuolto on erikoistunut pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluihin. Ketjun toiminnan perustana ovat laadukas palvelukokemus, asiantuntijuus ja tulevaisuuden rakentaminen. Ketju keskittyy erityisesti yritys- ja ammattiasiakkaisiin, yhtenä merkittävä kilpailuetuna mm. huollon sijaispakettiautot. Tällä hetkellä toimintaa on kolmella eri paikkakunnalla Suomessa, ketjun laajentuminen tulee tapahtumaan Suomen kaikkiin kasvukeskuksiin. Kasvunäkymät ovat vahvat ja konseptin mukaisella toiminnalla sekä ketjun vahvalla tuella on erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kannattavaan sekä laadukkaaseen yritystoimintaan. Ketju hyödyntää alan uusinta teknologiaa ja panostaa jatkuvaan kehitykseen, jotta palvelut pysyvät kilpailukykyisinä ja laadukkaina.

Franchising-yrittäjänä vastaat oman yksikkösi ja yhtiösi päivittäisestä toiminnasta. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat erityisesti asiakaspalvelu, huoltotöiden organisointi sekä henkilöstön johtaminen. Yrittäjänä olet myös vastuussa liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, paikallisesta markkinoinnista ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta. Työ on monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä päivät voivat sisältää sekä teknistä työtä että yrityksen hallinnollisia tehtäviä. Ketjun tuki ja selkeät toimintamallit auttavat sinua onnistumaan yrittäjänä.Yrittäjällä tulee olla taloudellisesti mahdollista panostaa yrittäjyyteen. Yrittäjän alkuinvestointi on 20.000€-50.000€ ja tyypillisesti omarahoitusosuus on 20-30% alkuinvestointimäärästä.

Menestyvä Pakettiautohuollon yrittäjä on:

1. Yrittäjähenkinen ja toimialasta kiinnostunut Kokemus autoalalta on hyödyksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu ja motivaatio oppia sekä kasvaa yrittäjänä Riskinkantokyky ja vastuunotto yrityksen toiminnasta

2. Asiakaslähtöinen ja myyntihenkinen Asiakaspalveluhenkinen, asiakaslähtöinen ajattelutapa ja myynnillinen ote

3. Tiimin ja tiimityöskentelyn johtaja Yhteistyökykyinen ja luotettava tiimipelaaja Rekrytoi ja kehittää henkilöstöä

4. Toiminnan kehittäjä ja laadun varmistaja Järjestelmällinen ja pitkäjänteiseen kehittymiseen sitoutuva Myönteinen ketjuasenne ja ketjun konseptin mukaiseen toimintaan sekä laatuvaatimuksiin sitoutuva

5. Taloudelliset edellytykset omaava Vakaa ja hyvä taloudellinen tilanne, mahdollisuus rahoittaa alkuinvestointi joko vapaana omana pääomana tai ulkopuolisella rahoituksella. Yksikön alkuinvestointivaatimus on: 20.000-50.000€ Yrityksen talouden ymmärrys ja tarkka talouden hallinta


Miksi yrittäjäksi Pakettiautohuolto-ketjuun:

1. Valmis konsepti ja toimintamallit

2. Tunnettuutta ja luottavuutta omaava Pakettiautohuollon brändi

3. Kilpailukyiset hankintasopimukset ja pakettiautoihin erikoistuminen. Lopputuloksena suoraviivainen ja tehokas korjaamotoiminta, onnistunut asiakaspalvelukokemus ja kannattava yritystoiminta

4. Markkinoinnin ja myynnin tuki ketjulta, ketjun valmiit asiakasrekisterit ja valtakunnalliset asiakkuudet

5. Ketjun kattava perehdytys, tärkeät tukipalvelut, valmiit järjestelmät ja jatkuva koulutus

6. Yhteistyö muiden yrittäjien kanssa


Yhteisössämme jokainen yrittäjä saa olla osa suurempaa joukkoa, jossa apua ja kannustusta on aina saatavilla yksin ei tarvitse pärjätä ja yrittää. Aloitus on helppoa, autamme liikepaikan löytämisessä ja sopimusneuvotteluissa. Koneiden ja työkalujen hankinnan osalta meillä on valmiit paketit olemassa.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, lue lisää ja jätä hakemus: https://ketju.fi/fi/ketju/429/pakettiautohuolto tai soita Ketju.fi rekrytointikonsultti Katja Makkonen, rekrytointi@ketju.fi, 020 730 7490

(HUOM! Etsimme yrittäjää, emme työntekijää.)

www.ketju.fi - sivusto on yrittäjyydestä kiinnostuneiden henkilöiden ja uusia yrittäjiä hakevien ketjujen kohtaamispaikka. Ketju.fi tarjoaa ketjuyrittäjyydestä kiinnostuneille ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden tutustua erilaisten ketjujen tarjoamiin yrittäjämahdollisuuksiin.

jobs.title: Business Developer Ernströmgruppen Business Area
jobs.description:
Business Developer Ernströmgruppen – Flow Technology Location: Gothenburg, Oslo or Copenhagen · Permanent, full-time

About us Ernströmgruppen is a family-owned Nordic industrial group. We own and grow entrepreneur-led niche companies, organised into four business areas. Flow Technology is one of them.

The companies in Flow Technology supply products, system solutions, installation and service for heating, cooling and ventilation, and for measuring and controlling flows. Some are product and system suppliers; others are dedicated service, installation and measurement businesses. Together they work across the Nordics and Northern Europe, and what connects them is a focus on using energy efficiently and making flow systems perform better.

We've spent a long time building better businesses, and we mean to keep doing it. That means getting our companies to work more closely together, making the right acquisitions when they come up, and putting new technology — AI included — to practical use. Decisions stay close to the business, but being part of Ernströmgruppen also opens doors beyond Flow Technology itself. We're looking for someone who wants to help build this.

The role We're adding a Business Developer to our Business Development team. You'll work closely with the team and, from that base, reach out across the Flow Technology companies to find and act on opportunities to grow. You'll drive initiatives independently while staying in close contact with the team. The work sits between strategy and delivery, and you'll be expected to carry things through to a result.

What you'll do

  • Drive business development across Flow Technology, with organic growth as the main focus

  • Find and develop synergies between our companies

  • Support acquisitions, from first analysis to integration

  • Help with change management, including the rollout of digital and AI initiatives

  • Work closely with senior managers across the companies to get people aligned and moving

  • Prepare analyses, business cases and decision material for management and the board

Who we're looking for You've worked in management consulting or a similar structured, project-driven setting, with roughly 2–5 years behind you. You're analytical, and you're good with people — you'll need both.

What matters most to us:

  • Strong relationship skills. You build trust easily and work well with people at every level, senior management included.

  • A structured, analytical way of working. You get to the heart of a business problem quickly and turn it into a clear plan someone can act on.

  • Experience with change management and with helping people adopt new ways of working.

  • A real feel for how organisations work and how decisions actually get made.

  • A hands-on, pragmatic streak, and comfort moving between the strategic and the operational.

Experience with AI in a business setting is a plus, not a requirement.

The role involves regular travel within the Nordics.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Armatec er et nordisk selskap i stadig utvikling. Vi er en del av Ernströmgruppen, et industrikonglomerat innen avanserte tekniske løsninger, som gir oss mange muligheter. Dette kan åpne døren for deg som ønsker å vokse i din nåværende rolle eller ønsker å påta deg nye roller og ansvarsområder på tvers av Armatec-selskapene i Norden.

Hos Armatec er vi litt over gjennomsnittet opptatt av å finne de beste tekniske løsningene for våre kunder. Vi tror de beste løsningene kommer med engasjement, arbeidsglede og kunnskap. Men det er klart vi har flere roller enn bare å foreslå tekniske løsninger. Vi jobber med alt fra innkjøp, logistikk, produktutvikling, salg, kundeservice, lager og teknisk montering.

Vi har kontorer i Norge, Sverige, Danmark og Finland, med hovedkontor i Gøteborg.
