jobs.title: Outcomes Growth Strategy and Programs Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s global Outcomes organization is focused on helping customers achieve business objectives with Notion. As the Growth Strategy & Programs Lead, you will help design and scale the programs, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives that make install-base growth more explosive and repeatable globally.

This is a high-impact strategy and programs role. You will create the clarity, structure, and execution systems that help the business grow existing customers more deliberately.

You will bring analytical rigor to how we understand growth, translate insights into scalable programs, and help teams execute with consistency while still allowing for local market nuance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a model, writing a crisp recommendation, aligning executive stakeholders, and turning a strategy into a practical field motion.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS, YOU WILL:

 - Learn Notion's post-sales operating model, regional execution model, and current install-base growth priorities.

 - Partner with RevOps, Data Science, Finance, Sales, Outcomes, and Services leaders to develop a practical view of the key drivers and leading indicators behind retention and expansion.

 - Identify a focused set of priority growth programs or plays to support the business in the near term.

 - Build the initial program plans, success metrics, stakeholder map, and operating cadence for those priority initiatives.

 - Partner with regional teams to understand how global programs should be adapted for local execution.

 - Create clear documentation, field-facing materials, and executive-ready updates that help teams align and act.

 - Establish a repeatable rhythm for reviewing progress, capturing learnings, and improving




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Help build a clear, shared view of the drivers behind expansion and adoption across Notion's customer base.

 - Design and scale global programs that support customer adoption, value realization, cross-sell, upsell, and durable growth.

 - Partner with regional and functional leaders to turn local learnings into repeatable playbooks, programs, and operating cadences.

 - Create measurement, reporting, and review mechanisms that help teams understand what is working and where to focus.

 - Support the design of customer growth motions that connect Sales, Services, and Partners.

 - Help codify best practices so growth becomes part of the standard operating rhythm, not a set of one-off campaigns.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive them from idea to operational execution.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience in management consulting, investment banking, business operations, or post-sales GTM operations.

 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; you can turn ambiguous business questions into clear frameworks, insights, and recommendations.

 - Proven ability to design and manage cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.

 - Strong stakeholder management across senior leaders and operating teams, with the ability to align people around a shared plan.

 - Excellent written communication, including crisp strategy docs, program plans, executive updates, and field-facing materials.

 - Comfort working in a global organization where programs need a strong central strategy and room for regional adaptation.

 - Ability to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and bring structure to fast-moving, ambiguous work.

 - Strong business judgment and curiosity about what drives customer adoption, retention, and expansion.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with usage-based, consumption-based, or product-led growth models.

 - Experience building or scaling global programs across multiple regions or customer segments.

 - Exposure to pricing, packaging, services, partners, or monetization initiatives.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $250k - $280k per year. 



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74. 



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de Parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire de parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel:
Type de contrat
CDI temps plein 35h
Lieu de travail
Conflans-Sainte-Honorine (78)
Salaire
2 000 à 2 300 euros brut par mois selon profil et expérience

Description de l'entreprise
We Rise est une société spécialisée dans la prestation technique événementielle basée en Ile-de-France. Nous accompagnons nos clients sur des événements professionnels, institutionnels, culturels et privés grâce à nos expertises en sonorisation, éclairage, vidéo, captation, murs LED et location de matériel.
Description du poste
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recrutons un Assistant Chargé de Production Technique & Gestionnaire de Dépôt. Ce poste est central dans l'organisation des prestations de l'entreprise.
Le titulaire du poste assurera la gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel, participera à la préparation technique des événements, coordonnera les ressources nécessaires à la bonne réalisation des prestations et assurera le suivi des sous-locations et fournisseurs.
Ce recrutement peut faire l'objet d'une POEI (Préparation Opérationnelle à l'Emploi Individuelle) en partenariat avec France Travail pour les candidats éligibles.

Missions principales
Gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel : suivi des entrées et sorties, organisation du dépôt, préparation des commandes, contrôle des retours, inventaires, suivi SAV et réparations, maintenances préventives, gestion des consommables.
Préparation technique des prestations : analyse des besoins techniques, construction des listes de matériel dans Rentman, vérification des disponibilités, identification des besoins en sous-location, préparation des dossiers techniques et briefs équipes, rédaction des feuilles de route.
Coordination opérationnelle : planification des équipes techniques, organisation des chargements et déchargements, suivi opérationnel des projets, circulation des informations entre les intervenants.
Gestion des sous-locations et fournisseurs : identification des besoins, consultation des fournisseurs, suivi des devis, organisation des retraits et retours de matériel sous-loué.

Profil recherché
Expérience indispensable dans la prestation technique événementielle, acquise chez un prestataire technique audiovisuel ou une structure événementielle. Une expérience en préparation de matériel, exploitation, régie, sonorisation, éclairage ou vidéo constitue un atout.
Formation souhaitée : BTS Métiers de l'Audiovisuel, BTS Techniques du Spectacle, Licence Professionnelle ou formation équivalente dans les métiers de l'événementiel.

Compétences requises
Bonne connaissance de l'environnement de la prestation technique événementielle. Bonne culture générale des métiers du son, de l'éclairage et de la vidéo. Excellente aisance informatique et appétence pour les logiciels métiers. La connaissance de Rentman constitue un plus. Organisation, rigueur, sens des responsabilités, esprit d'équipe et capacité d'apprentissage.
Evolution du poste
Selon les compétences et l'autonomie acquises, des évolutions vers les fonctions de Chargé de Production Technique, Coordinateur Technique ou Responsable Exploitation Technique sont envisagées.

Avantages
Heures supplémentaires rémunérées ou récupérées. Formation et accompagnement à la prise de poste.

Candidature
Merci de lire cette annonce jusqu'au bout avant de postuler.
Pour que votre candidature soit étudiée, vous devez impérativement remplir le formulaire de candidature à l'adresse suivante :
https://forms.gle/63tGZx4rHBMD3SQm8
Les candidatures transmises sans formulaire complété ne seront pas traitées.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • taler dansk eller engelsk
  • er venlig, selvstændig og serviceorienteret
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for rengøringsbranchen.


Det tilbyder vi:

  • En fast plads i et team på to, der deler arbejdet ligeligt – I skiftes til vagterne og holder altid fri på skift
  • Fast gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid med timekonto: i gennemsnit ca. 10 timer om ugen pr. person – mest i højsæsonen (juli–august, op til ca. 20 timer/uge), mindre om vinteren (ca. 3 timer/uge), når I tager ferie og udnytter kompensationsfrihed. simon.kilimann@noordwind.eu

jobs.description:
Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway

 

We are looking for a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent position in Northern Norway.

You will join a well-functioning outpatient clinic and work closely with an experienced team. The region is known for its relaxed pace of life, strong professional environments, and supportive colleagues.

Your role
  • Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Contribute actively to interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervise junior doctors and support internal training
  • Take part in developing the service and improving clinical practice
Qualifications
  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Good English skills and motivation to learn Norwegian (language training provided)
  • Solid clinical competence and ability to work independently
What the clinic offers
  • Permanent position in a stable and well-organized outpatient unit
  • Close collaboration with experienced and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours, with options for extended shifts and additional pay
  • Access to courses, seminars, and continuous professional development
  • Optional participation in acute care rotation, with extra compensation
  • Pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Why Northern Norway?

Northern Norway offers a unique combination of professional opportunities and quality of life.

You get access to modern healthcare facilities while living close to nature. The region is known for its dramatic landscapes, with mountains, fjords, and coastline right outside your door.

It is a great place for both individuals and families. You will find good schools, safe communities, and a slower, more balanced lifestyle.

Outdoor activities are part of everyday life — whether it is hiking, skiing, fishing, or simply enjoying the Northern Lights in winter and the midnight sun in summer.

Despite the remote location, you have access to regional airports and solid connections to the rest of Norway and Europe.

Benefits with Dignus Medical
  • Free Norwegian language course tailored for healthcare professionals
  • Personal follow-up throughout the entire recruitment process
  • Relocation support for you and your family (housing, schools, kindergartens)

  • Guidance with authorization, paperwork, and practical matters

     

Interested?

 

Take the first step towards a new career and lifestyle in Norway. Contact us for a confidential and informal chat!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Psychiatrist wanted for position in adult psychiatry in Southern Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of a well-established outpatient clinic in Southern Norway, we are recruiting a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent role in adult psychiatry.

You will become part of a competent interdisciplinary team in a region known for its mild climate and friendly communities.

 

Your role

  • Assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of adult patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Active participation in interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervision of junior doctors and contribution to internal training
  • Engagement in the clinic’s development and professional improvements

Qualifications

  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Fluent in English and motivated to learn Norwegian (language training will be provided)
  • Broad competence in adult psychiatry and ability to work independently

The clinic offers

  • A permanent position in a stable and well-functioning outpatient unit
  • An interdisciplinary team with skilled and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours and opportunities for extended shifts with extra pay
  • Access to professional courses, seminars, and specialist development days
  • Possibility to take part in acute care rotation (optional, extra pay)
  • Secure pension and insurance schemes via KLP

Why Southern Norway?

 

Southern Norway (Sørlandet) combines modern healthcare infrastructure with a high quality of life. The region is family-friendly, with good schools, kindergartens and accessible housing.

With a milder climate than most other parts of Norway, Sørlandet is especially known as a popular holiday destination during summer, attracting both Norwegians and international visitors to its charming towns and cultural scene. At the same time, the region offers a relaxed pace of life year-round, with plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and cultural events.

 

International airports and proximity to Oslo, make it easy to stay connected with the rest of Europe. You can read more about the area at Visit Southern Norway.

  • Free online Norwegian language course tailored to medical professionals
  • Personalized follow-up throughout the recruitment process

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Århus
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få lakken til at skinne igen! 

Er du den, der får et tilfredsstillende sug i maven, når en bil forlader kabinen med en spejlblank finish? Elsker du duften af frisk lak og præcision i hver eneste sprøjtning? Så er det dig, vi leder efter!

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Hvad skal du lave?

Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Ansvarsområde er kabinen og du skal være med til at sikre den daglig drift i kabinen.
  • Sikre jævnt flow, korrekt farvematch og en finish, der spiller.
  • Selvom du har et medansvar for kabinen, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens.

Hvem er du?

Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har erfaring med sprøjtelakering – enten som udlært autolakerer eller med solid erfaring.
  • Går op i kvalitet og finish – du lakerer ikke bare, du skaber mesterværker.
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver
  • Har B-kørekort – så bilerne ikke kun ser flotte ud, men også kan flyttes.
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens.

Hvad får du?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi ved, hvad dygtige folk er værd!
  • Gode kollegaer, der deler din passion for lakering og håndværk.
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med
  • Mulighed for udvikling
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med humor og højt til loftet.
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener.

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige lakmester med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette.

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme. 

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Susanne Damgaard Petersen på 30432854

jobs.title: KOKK - Chef De Cuisine - Fulltime
jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are seeking for highly skilled and experienced Indian curry & tandoori Chefs to join our team at India Tandoori, a premium establishment specializing in authentic Indian cuisine. The ideal candidates will have extensive experience working with Tandoori and traditional Indian cooking methods, especially North Indian, South Indian, and Awadhi cuisines.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and cook a variety of dishes, with a focus on Tandoori and traditional Indian flavors.

  • Maintain high standards of hygiene and kitchen safety.

  • Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency meet the restaurant's high standards.

  • Collaborate with the kitchen team to innovate and improve the menu.

  • Oversee the kitchen operations during service and ensure smooth workflow.

Requirements:

  • Completed education or degree from a recognized university or college, such as a 3-year Hotel Management degree.

  • At least 7 years of relevant professional education and/or work experience in Indian cuisine, particularly in Tandoori cooking and related culinary techniques.

  • Experience in preparing North Indian, South Indian, and Awadhi cuisine.

  • At least half of your practical experience must have been gained working in a restaurant or hotel of a high standard.

  • Strong knowledge of traditional Indian cooking techniques and spices, especially in Tandoori cooking.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure kitchen environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Previous experience working in international or upscale restaurants is an advantage.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with a diverse team.

Application Process: Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and educational background. We look forward to hearing how your skills and expertise can contribute to the continued success of our restaurant.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Our Restaurant India Tandoori is Norway's oldest Indian restaurant, established in 1991. We are a family-owned Indian restaurant known for our authentic specialties and are proud to offer an unforgettable dining experience. Our goal is to ensure that each guest leaves feeling satisfied, happy, and eager to return. We take great pride in making sure our visitors are not only well-fed but also enjoy an exceptional experience that brings them back for more.

jobs.title: MARKETING EXECUTIVE
Senior Technical Program Manager, Security
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own our vulnerability management program end to end. In this role, you will drive vulnerability intake, triage, remediation, and reporting across our bug bounty program, our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, source code hosted on GitHub, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS services. You will partner closely with platform engineering, product engineering, SRE, security, IT, legal, and vendor management to make sure vulnerabilities are found fast, triaged accurately, and closed within SLA — and that leadership always has a clear, current picture of the organization's risk posture.The ideal candidate uses AI and automation aggressively to scale themselves, but understands that the core value is clarity, tradeoffs, and execution, not just tooling.



What you'll do:

 - Program Ownership: Own and continuously improve the vulnerability management program, including intake, severity scoring (CVSS/risk-based), SLA definition, and remediation tracking across all asset types.

 - Bug Bounty Operations: Manage the triage/payouts/rewards workflow, and report on program health and trends.

 - Cloud Remediation (GCP): Drive remediation of vulnerabilities found in GCP infrastructure — IAM, networking, Compute/GKE, storage, and logging/monitoring configuration — by partnering with security, cloud, and platform engineering teams.

 - Code & Supply Chain Security: Coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced through SAST/DAST/SCA tooling (Wiz Code, Snyk, Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning) across engineering repos, including dependency and supply-chain risk.

 - SaaS Vendor Risk: Build and manage the process for assessing and tracking security posture across third-party SaaS applications.

 - Escalation & Exceptions: Define and enforce escalation paths for overdue or critical/high-severity findings, including risk acceptance and exception processes with appropriate sign-off.

 - Cross-Team Accountability: Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to embed remediation work into sprint planning and hold teams accountable to remediation SLAs.

 - Reporting & Alerting: Establish and maintain a single source of truth for vulnerability status, aging, SLA compliance, and risk trends, with dashboards for engineering leadership, security leadership, and executives.

 - Audit & Compliance Support: Support audit and compliance efforts (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires) by keeping vulnerability management evidence and metrics audit-ready.

 - Process & Automation: Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual triage effort and improve time-to-remediation across all vulnerability sources.



Required Skill & Experience:

 - Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in technical program management, security program management, or security operations, with direct ownership of a vulnerability management or application security program.

 - Bug Bounty Expertise: Hands-on experience running a bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti), including triage and payout workflows.

 - Cloud Security Knowledge (GCP): Working knowledge of GCP security fundamentals: IAM, VPC/networking, Security Command Center, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and common cloud misconfiguration risks.

 - Code Security Familiarity: Familiarity with GitHub-based development workflows and code security tooling (Wiz Code, Dependabot, SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or CodeQL).

 - Risk Prioritization: Strong grasp of vulnerability scoring frameworks (CVSS) and risk-based prioritization.

 - Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills — able to translate technical vulnerability data into business risk for executive audiences and hold engineering teams accountable without owning the code themselves.

 - Reporting Tools: Proven ability to build reporting/dashboards (e.g., Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, Tableau, Looker) that give leadership real-time visibility into program health.

 - Compliance Awareness: Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or FedRAMP.



What we value:

 - Systems Thinking: The ability to see the “big picture” and understand how vulnerability management decisions impact the entire stack — cloud, code, and vendor ecosystem alike.

 - Technical Influence: The ability to drive alignment across engineering and security through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.

 - Autonomy: Comfortable owning a program end to end and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Bias for Action: A track record of closing the gap between finding a vulnerability and actually getting it fixed.
   
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

Job posting in English below

Pour ce faire, CI est devenu un leader mondial des communications par satellites (SATCOM) civiles et militaires capable de concevoir et opérer des infrastructures en propre ou pour ses clients. Pour maintenir ce leadership, CI mène une politique ambitieuse d'innovation afin d'étoffer son portefeuille de solutions à haute valeur ajoutée.

Dans ce but, CI cherche un/une Architecte réseaux Laser en espace libre (H/F) maîtrisant les technologies de communication par Laser et la réalisation de réseaux incluant des segments Laser :
Réseau IP conventionnels;
Réseaux point à point, point à multipoint, maillés, ... ;
Porteurs fixes et mobiles;
Milieux : spatial, aérien, terrestre, maritime.


Vous avez un intérêt pour les réseaux IP et les systèmes de communication complexes, hautement sécurisés. Vous êtes capable de faire preuve de créativité et avez l'envie de vous investir sur des sujets techniques complexes et innovants. Vous serez intégré(e) à un pôle d'ingénierie chargé de concevoir et développer les systèmes de communication de défense du futur.  

Les activités actuelles de l'équipe ont pour but d'exploiter les possibilités offertes par les technologies émergentes (laser, quantique,...) dans le cadre des services de communications sécurisés, sur tout type de support (satellite, 5G,...), en utilisant des techniques de réseaux programmables (SDN).

Vous prendrez part en tant qu'Architecte aux différents projets faisant appel aux moyens de communication Laser.

Ce poste exige une connaissance des risques potentiels de non-conformité.

Le/la titulaire s'engage à agir avec intégrité, fondement du succès et de la croissance durable de la Société.

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous aurez les missions suivantes :
Assurer une veille technologique permanente au contact des équipes internes et des équipementiers ;
Supporter les avant ventes à savoir (ex : pédagogie envers les équipes internes et envers les clients; proposition de solutions techniques) ;
Maquetter des solutions ou des preuves de concept ;
Contribuer à la conception des solutions destinées aux clients (ex: spécification des segments Laser; Interface avec les autres composants systèmes) ;
Spécifier les évolutions nécessaires des composant Airbus Defence & Space pour implémenter ces solutions et identifier d'éventuels nouveaux composants à développer ;
Assurer le maintien de tous les documents techniques liés aux solutions proposées ;
Support et expertise aux équipes de conception et d'IVQ système.


Profil :

Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
Titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur (ou équivalent) dans le domaine des réseaux informatiques avec une spécialisation sur les systèmes optiques Laser et Optoélectronique ;
Expérience dans des environnements réseaux complexes, typés opérateurs télécom ou militaire ou WAN étendus de grands groupes ou d'OIV ;
Capacité reconnue à concevoir et réaliser des solutions techniques livrées à des clients ;
Connaissance des problématiques de transmission par laser ainsi que des réseaux IP classiques ;
Notions d'ingénierie des systèmes complexes ;
Vous êtes autonome et désireux de porter des sujets innovants ;
Vous savez travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires et avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles ;
Niveau de négociation en Français et avancé en Anglais.


====

Join Airbus Defence & Space !

Within Airbus Defence and Space CIS, the role of the Connected Intelligence (CI) business unit is to provide its customers with secure, high-speed, multimedia (voice, data, video) communications solutions available at any time and anywhere in the world.

To achieve this, CI has become a world leader in civil and military satellite communications (SATCOM), capable of designing and operating infrastructure on its own or for its customers. To maintain this leadership, CI is pursuing an ambitious policy of innovation to expand its portfolio of high value-added solutions.

To this end, CI is looking for a Free Space Laser Network Architect (M/F) who is proficient in laser communication technologies and the implementation of networks including laser segments:
Conventional IP network;
Point to point, point to multipoint, mesh networks, ... ;
Fixed and mobile carriers;
Environments: space, air, land, sea.


You have an interest in IP networks and complex, highly secure communication systems.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Business Development
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Develop and implement BDR processes, playbooks, and best practices for cold and warm-outbound channels

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Partner with sales leadership to provide feedback on territory assignments, quotas, performance metrics, lead handoff processes

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ensuring your team can articulate this vision compellingly

 - Collaborate with marketing and operations to optimize lead routing, provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, and improve lead quality & conversion

 - Analyze team performance data and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and meeting quality

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDR/BDR team members as the organization scales

 - Maintain accountability for team quota attainment and individual BDR development

 - Work closely with Account Executives and AE leaders to ensure smooth handoffs and tight feedback loops

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of sales development experience with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role, preferably some with a technical ICP

 - Proven track record of building and scaling BDR teams, preferably in a high-growth environment

 - Strong individual contributor background with deep understanding of both inbound & outbound prospecting, demand gen strategies, and industry best practices

 - Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing junior sales talent

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Ability to recruit, interview, and assess SDR candidates effectively

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with marketing and sales teams

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience building inbound SDR programs from 0-1 and/or scaling from early stage

 - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

 - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM (Salesforce coming soon)

 - ZoomInfo

 - Outreach

 - Gong

 - Chorus

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - Nooks

 - Default

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You're not based in the Salt Lake City area and/or willing to relocate

 - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts

 - You're not passionate about AI

 - You prefer individual contributor work over people management and team building

 - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly



This is a full-time hybrid role and has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Lastbilchauffør søges til faste ture - Fredericia
jobs.description:
X max ApS søger lige nu dygtige lastbilchauffører til vores afdeling i Fredericia.

Som chauffør hos os får du en hverdag præget af faste ture med få stops. Du kender dine ruter, og vi prioriterer et roligt arbejdsmiljø uden stressende bytrafik eller konstante nye leveringsadresser. Det giver dig mulighed for at fokusere på sikker kørsel og overblik.

Du møder ind i Fredericia og kører ud på dine fastlagte ture. Arbejdstiden er fuldtid (5 dage om ugen) med ca. 10 timers effektiv arbejdstid om dagen, planlagt med fornuftige køreplaner og respekt for pauser.

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har et gyldigt CE-kørekort.

  • Har erfaring med kørsel med trækker og trailer.

  • Kan kommunikere på enten dansk eller engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt (nødvendigt for sikkerhed og kundekontakt).

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, punktlig og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Sætter pris på klare rammer, faste rutiner og et velorganiseret arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

  • Høj løn – vi belønner din erfaring og indsats.

  • Faste ture – du ved, hvad du skal, og hvor du skal hen.

  • Få stops – ingen stressende jagt på mange små adresser.

  • Udgangspunkt fra vores depot i Fredericia.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på trivsel, godt samarbejde og ordentlige forhold.

  • Et internationalt miljø, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed.

Ansøgning

Er du den stabile og erfarne chauffør, vi mangler i teamet i Fredericia? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag. Vi ser gerne ansøgninger på både dansk og engelsk.

Send din ansøgning til: xmax-online@outlook.com Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til os på 28 19 98 18.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

X max ApS – Professionel transportløsning med personlig touch.

**************************************************************************************************************

**************************************************************************************************************

Truck Driver Wanted for Fixed Routes - Fredericia

X max ApS is currently looking for skilled truck drivers for our department in Fredericia.

As a driver with us, you will experience a workday characterized by fixed routes with few stops. You know your routes, and we prioritize a calm working environment without stressful city traffic or constantly changing delivery addresses. This allows you to focus on safe driving and maintaining an overview.

You will report to our location in Fredericia and drive your predetermined routes. This is a full-time position (5 days a week) with approximately 10 effective working hours per day, planned with sensible schedules and respect for rest breaks.

We expect that you:

  • Hold a valid CE driver’s license

  • Have experience driving with a tractor and trailer

  • Can communicate in either Danish or English – both verbally and in writing (necessary for safety and customer contact)

  • Are responsible, punctual, and able to work independently

  • Appreciate clear frameworks, fixed routines, and well-organized work

We offer:

  • High salary – we reward your experience and effort

  • Fixed routes – you know what you need to do and where you need to go

  • Few stops – no stressful rush to many small addresses

  • Base location at our depot in Fredericia

  • A strong team focused on well-being, good collaboration, and proper working conditions

  • An international environment where we value diversity

Application
Are you the stable and experienced driver we are looking for in our Fredericia team? Then send your application and CV today. We welcome applications in both Danish and English.

Send your application to: xmax-online@outlook.com
If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to call us at 28 19 98 18.

We look forward to hearing from you!

X max ApS – Professional transport solutions with a personal touch.

jobs.title: Electronics Production Technician
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

jobs.title: Nurse
jobs.description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

www.ill.eu/careers

Employer: Bloomfield Hospital Location: Stocking Lane, Rathfarnham Dublin 16, Ireland Hours of work per week: 39 hours weekly/78 hours fortnightly About Bloomfield: Bloomfield Hospital provides a spectrum of neuropsychiatric services to adults with a range of severe and enduring mental health needs such as Alzheimer`s, Parkinson`s, and Huntington`s Diseases, as well as individuals with early onset dementias, schizophrenia and mood disorders. We are the only facility in Ireland that provides a high level of specialized care for people with Huntington’s disease. In Bloomfield Hospital there is a focus on creating a therapeutic environment by using recovery-oriented clinical practices and therapeutic interventions, which are evidence-based to enable and support patients to achieve their highest level of functioning and quality of life. Description & Responsibilities: Wash patients in bed shower or bath as required. Making beds. Help patients/residents to dress. Lift, move, turn, and re-position patients, using the appropriate equipment at all times. Care of incontinent, colostomy, and ileostomy patients. Supervise incontinent, colostomy, and ileostomy patients in toilets, on commodes, and in bathrooms and assist with appropriate hygiene and incontinence wear. Give and remove bedpans, urinals, and commodes as required. Record and monitor bowel function, measuring urinary output, output from IDC, and urostomy. Notify nursing staff throughout the shift. Understand, assist, and promote patients’ oral hygiene including denture care. Care for patients’ hair and nails as required. Shave male patients. Mobilise and help patients to exercise as required. Ensure the comfort and safety of patients are met as per local policy. Assist patients/residents as per care plan with nutritional intake and record keeping of same. Assist nurses with procedures when necessary. Weigh patients using appropriate equipment specific to the patient’s/resident’s needs. Record, inform, and report to nursing staff. Give and remove emesis containers and sputum cartons. Understand the basics of skin integrity and promote and maintain the same through positive interventions. Maintain active communication with nursing staff. Assist the nursing staff with pressure sore prevention and care. Person Specification: The successful candidate will have completed a QQI Level 5 or Fetac 5 (8 modules) in Healthcare or Pre-Nursing or similar Nursing Qualification. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience. Previous experience in a psychiatric environment is an advantage. Care Skills and Care Support are essential. Our benefits include: Generous shift premiums (25% night duty, double time Sundays and bank holidays). Contributory pension. Fixed roster patterns. Further education supports available. Comprehensive training. Free onsite staff parking. Subsidised restaurant. Employee assistance programme. Uniforms supplied on commencement of employment. Cycle to work Scheme

jobs.title: Tutor | Mentor | Lektiehjælper | Online | Privatunderviser | Folkeskole og gymnasie
jobs.description:
Engagerede tutorer søges!

Arbejdssted: Online (eller nær dit hjem)
Ansættelsesform: Deltid/Freelance
Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt

Om os:
Tutora er en innovativ og voksende virksomhed, som tilbyder privat lektiehjælp til elever i folkeskolen og gymnasiet både online og fysisk. Vi tror på, at den rette undervisning kan gøre en verden til forskel, og derfor søger vi engagerede og dygtige tutorer, som vil være med på vores tutorteam.

Jobbeskrivelse:
Som tutor hos Tutora vil du få mulighed for at undervise elever i forskellige fag og hjælpe dem med at opnå deres mål. Vi søger tutorer inden for følgende områder:

  • Dansk

  • Matematik

  • Nat.vid. fag (fysik, kemi, biologi m.m.)

  • Humanistiske og samf.vid. fag (engelsk, samfundsfag, tysk m.m.)

Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Forberedelse og gennemførelse af undervisningslektioner online og/eller fysisk.

  • Løbende kommunikation med elever og forældre om fremskridt, planlægning m.m.

Vi forventer at du:

  • Har stærke faglige kompetencer inden for et eller flere af de ovennævnte fag.

  • Er tålmodig, engageret og brænder for at hjælpe andre med at lære.

  • Kan tage ansvar og administrere et undervisningsforløb fra start til slut selvstændigt og pålideligt.

  • Har erfaring med undervisning eller tutoring (ikke et krav, men en fordel).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Fleksible arbejdstider, der kan tilpasses din kalender.

  • En meningsfuld og givende rolle, hvor du kan gøre en forskel.

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn baseret på erfaring og kvalifikationer (145 - 170 DKK/time).

  • Et støttende og venligt arbejdsmiljø.

Ansøgning:
Er du klar til at blive en del af vores tutorteam og hjælpe elever med at nå deres fulde potentiale? SEND DIN ANSØGNING HER. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på 28962740 eller via email på info@tutora.dk.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:



1) Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

2) Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

3) People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

4) People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1) Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

2) Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

 - Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.

3) Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.

4) Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Embedded, not independent: You will work as an extension of strategic People Partner leaders and existing Talent Management team, not as a separate talent silo.

 - Strategic + practical: You can shape philosophy at 10,000 feet and turn it into an executable V1 strategy in a week – not for the purpose of moving fast, but for getting opinions and engagement of the right solution fast.

 - High taste, low ego: You have strong opinions about what great talent work looks like, but you build through partnership and field feedback.

 - Systems-minded: You design for repeatability and leverage, while knowing when to do the unscalable thing first.

 - Business-first: You anchor talent work in company outcomes, not HR activity.

 - AI-native and Notion-powered: You are energized by reimagining how talent work should change when AI can remove manual coordination and amplify judgment. You also understand how Notion can support our initiatives.

 - Path-agnostic: You’re glad to start as an individual contributor and build the case for a team through impact, not title.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. jobs.title: Architecte Systèmes et Virtualisation VMware (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Le consultant devra réaliser un état des lieux du parc de virtualisation existant analyser les usages et fonctionnalités VMware réellement activés recueillir et structurer les besoins des équipes techniques et des métiers comparer les solutions alternatives disponibles sur le marché évaluer leur couverture fonctionnelle, leur maturité et leur capacité à supporter les volumes concernés étudier les possibilités de migration et les contraintes de réversibilité définir les scénarios cibles possibles construire une trajectoire technologique à moyen et long terme piloter ou préparer des preuves de concept animer les différents experts internes synthétiser les conclusions restituer les recommandations aux DSI et aux instances de direction.

Profil recherché

Description du profil :

Le besoin porte sur un Lead Architecte ou Architecte transverse senior , avec une véritable posture de consultant stratégique.

Les compétences indispensables

Les compétences indispensables sont une forte expérience d'architecture VMware une expérience significative sur OpenStack une bonne connaissance des solutions alternatives de virtualisation une expérience des infrastructures à très grande échelle une compréhension des problématiques de datacenter, de réseau, de stockage et de matériel une capacité à raisonner comme un fournisseur de cloud privé une expérience de l'industrialisation et de la mise à disposition rapide de services une capacité à construire et défendre une conviction technologique une excellente aptitude à l'animation, à la synthèse et à la restitution auprès de dirigeants.

Attentes sur la posture

Le candidat ne doit pas être uniquement un administrateur ou un architecte technique spécialisé dans l'exploitation.

Dimension de l'environnement

Dimension de l'environnement

Le consultant interviendra sur une infrastructure d'une taille très importante, équivalente à plusieurs dizaines de milliers de machines ou d'unités techniques.

Une expérience limitée à des plateformes unitaires, des prototypes ou des environnements de petite taille ne sera pas suffisante Contraintes liées

Le profil devra comprendre les contraintes liées au fonctionnement d'un cloud provider interne à l'industrialisation des déploiements aux infrastructures majoritairement hébergées sur site au déploiement de services nécessitant du matériel ;

à une trajectoire de transformation sur trois à quatre ans

  • Planiranje i organiziranje održavanja: izrada plana godišnjeg preventivnog održavanje, definira godišnje ciljeve i aktivnosti koji su uključeni u pripremu strategije tvrtke, sudjeluje u pripremi pokazatelja vrijednosti za ciljeve, sudjeluje u pripremi programa upravljanja okolišem koji su uključeni u planiranje i organiziranje investicijskih projekata, organiziranje provođenja redovitih mišljenja o stanju strojeva i opreme te otklanja pronađene pogreške.
  • Vodi i kontrolira provedbu investicijskih projekata i nadgleda provedbu redovitih preventivnih pregleda strojeva i uređaja, prati i daje izvješća o zastojima u radu i poteškoćama, kontrolira otklanjanje kvarova, potvrđuje interne naloge za održavanje, upravlja troškovima održavanja za postizanje ciljeva i maksimiziranje dobiti, priprema sve potrebne izvještaje.
  • Planira i izrađuje ciljeve za podređene zaposlenike, sudjeluje u izradi plana obrazovanja i osposobljavanja i osposobljavanja na radnom mjestu, utvrđuje učinkovitost obrazovanja i osposobljavanja, ocjenjuje rad i izvedbu podređenih zaposlenika, predlaže nagrade i promocije, organizira vođenje evidencije prisutnosti i odsutnosti s rada svojih podređenih, potiče zaposlenike na davanje korisnih prijedloga, organizira mentorstvo, potiče zaposlenike da prijavljuju eventualne opasnosti od nezgode i ozljede na radu.
  • Komunicira interno, te prema vani, voditelj je u procesu rada prema podređenim zaposlenicima i dobavljačima.
  • Sudjelovanje u procesu racionalizacije potrošnje energije.
  • Sudjelovanje u projektnim timovima, praćenje provedbe, kontrola projektne dokumentacije.
  • Poznavanje propisa i promjena u zakonodavstvu i njihovo uvođenje u provedbu postavljenih zadaća.
  • Za vrijeme svoje odsutnosti, iz bilo kojeg razloga, dužan je osigurati da se rad obavlja bez problema i osigurati zamjenu.
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.
  • Odgovornost za realizaciju planova održavanja u pogonu.
  • Odgovornost za funkcioniranje elektro i strojnog održavanja.
  • Odgovornost za rad u skladu sa Zakonom o radu, Zakonom o očuvanju okoliša i zahtjevima sustava ISO standarda.
  • Odgovornost za funkcionalnu i pouzdanu raspoloživost strojeva za proizvodnju.
  • Odgovornost za racionalno i učinkovito korištenje i naručivanje rezervnih dijelova.
  • Odgovornost za remonte i planirane zastoje stroja dogovara s voditeljem pogona i svojim nadređenim.
  • Odgovornost za upotrebu osobne zaštitne opreme i za poštovanje uputa za siguran rad svih podređenih.

jobs.title: 2. SPASILAC / SPASITELJICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 30. Statuta, ravnatelj ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Trg Krešimira Ćosića 11, Zagreb, raspisuje J AV N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam radnika u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme 2. Naziv radnog mjesta: SPASILAC (m/ž) – 4 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice Rad s punim radnim vremenom, neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Zagreb Sprema: VKV/SSS, važeće uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa Koeficijent složenosti poslova: 1,61 Radno iskustvo: 1 godina Posebna znanja i vještine: nisu potrebna Opis poslova: vrši nadzor vodene površine s kopna ili čamca te površine bazena, provodi preventivne aktivnosti vezane uz sigurnost korisnika te brinu za sigurnost korisnika u smislu životne ugroze i spašavanja iz vode, pruža neodgodivu prvu pomoć, vrši neprekidan nadzor na svom području djelovanja za koje je zadužen i odgovoran tijekom u vremenu utvrđenom rasporedom, nadzire poštivanje bazenskog i plažnog reda, brine za čistoću bazena, raspored pruga, rekvizita i opreme na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, dnevno obavlja čišćenje bazenskog oplošja i/ili plaže, sudjeluje u pripremi i realizaciji sportskih natjecanja ili drugih događanja na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, osigurava natjecanja na vodi te druge manifestacije u blizini vode, daje informacije korisnicima u smislu uputa i pravila za korištenje bazena, jezera ili plaže, uz spasilačke poslove, sudjeluje kao ispomoć realizatorima sportskih programa u provođenju sportskih programa, provjere plivanja i dr., prema potrebi, obavlja redarske poslove na prostoru cijelog objekta, odgovoran je za stanje skladišta rekvizita i opreme, vodi pisanu evidenciju o dnevnom čišćenju bazena, intervencijama te oštećenjima na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, sudjeluje u remontu bazena, prvenstveno u čišćenju školjke i oplošja bazena, obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog u okviru stručne spreme i djelokruga rada. Plaću radnika čine osnovna odnosno ugovorena plaća i dodaci na osnovnu plaću. Osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojemu radnik radi i osnovice za izračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5 % za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obavezni probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci. Kandidati su u prijavi dužni navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresa), naziv i redni broj radnog mjesta za koje se podnosi prijava. Kandidati koji se natječu za više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu. Uz svaku prijavu dužni su priložiti traženu dokumentaciju. Kandidati su prilikom prijave dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju: • prijavu za javni natječaj (obrazac prijave može se preuzeti na web-stranici Ustanove: https://www.sportskiobjekti.hr/pravilnici-i-natjecaji/1164), • životopis, • dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica, vojna iskaznica ili domovnica), • dokaz o stručnoj spremi: presliku diplome ili svjedodžbe (ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži inozemnu kvalifikaciju, dužan je uz istu dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije), • uvjerenje o nevođenju kaznenog postupka (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja), • uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa (preslika uvjerenja) – za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 2., • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu, ne stariji od 1 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja: Elektronički zapis (e–radna knjižica) ili Potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji Zapis/Potvrda, između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu, općini rada – prebivališta i trajanju staža osiguranja. Kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku dužni su uz istu dostaviti ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) Temeljem članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihove obitelji (Narodne novine, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) i članka 49. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i dokumentaciju navedenu u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati prijavljeni na javni natječaj bit će pozvani pisanim putem na prethodnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se primaju. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave javnog natječaja u novinama, na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči HZZ-a te na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima. Prijave s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – PRIJAM U RADNI ODNOS – NAZIV I REDNI BROJ RADNOG MJESTA ZA KOJE SE PODNOSI PRIJAVA“ dostavljaju se na adresu: Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Baštijanova 52a, 10 000 Zagreb. Ustanova Upravljanje sportskim objektima zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu, odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid
* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt.
Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
About the role We are seeking a Mechanical Technician to join our team supporting underground mining operations in Navan, Ireland. Working as part of a small, highly collaborative maintenance team, you will be responsible for maintaining, servicing, troubleshooting, and repairing bulk explosives pumping systems and associated equipment used in underground mining environments. This is a hands-on role that requires a strong mechanical background, a proactive attitude, and the ability to work independently in a safety-critical environment. While the primary focus is mechanical maintenance, knowledge of electrical systems, PLCs, and industrial controls would be highly advantageous. The successful candidate will play a critical role in supporting equipment reliability, operational uptime, and safe production outcomes while working closely with operational and maintenance stakeholders underground. What you will be doing Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair bulk explosives pumping equipment and associated mechanical systems used in underground mining operations. Perform preventative and corrective maintenance activities to maximise equipment reliability and availability. Diagnose and resolve mechanical faults, supporting operational continuity and minimising downtime. Assist in identifying and resolving electrical and PLC-related issues where required, collaborating with specialist support teams as necessary. Support maintenance planning and execution activities to ensure safe and efficient operations. Participate in on-call rotations and respond to maintenance call-outs outside standard working hours when required. Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation. Work collaboratively across site functions, supporting operational requirements beyond core trade responsibilities when needed. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all Safety, Health, Environment and Security (SHES) standards, policies, and procedures. Align all activities with Orica’s Charter Values, Purpose, and Strategy. What you will bring Relevant trade qualification, diploma, degree, or equivalent experience in Mechanical Maintenance or a related discipline. Experience working in industrial, mining, heavy equipment, maintenance, or similar environments. Experience maintaining pumps, hydraulic systems, rotating equipment, or similar mechanical systems. Previous underground mining experience is strongly preferred. Knowledge of electrical systems, industrial controls, or PLCs would be highly advantageous. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a practical, hands-on approach. Ability to work independently and safely in a remote operational environment. Strong work ethic and willingness to contribute across multiple operational activities. Effective communication and collaboration skills. This role requires participation in an on-call roster, including out-of-hours and weekend call-outs.
